Message:
療 Pecan Pie Cupcakes 療
Ingredients:
For the Butter Pecan Cupcakes:
1 cups 255g unsalted butter, softened divided: 1 cup  2 tablespoons
2 cups 240g chopped pecans
2 cups 400g granulated sugar
4 large eggs
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 cup 120g all-purpose flour
2 cups 240g cake flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 cup 240ml whole milk
For the Brown Sugar Cream Cheese Frosting:
8 ounces 227g cream cheese, room temperature
 cup 170g unsalted butter, room temperature
 cup 150g dark brown sugar
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
3 cups 360g powdered sugar
 cup 75g toasted and chopped pecans, for garnish
Directions:
Prepare the Cupcake Pan: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a cupcake pan with paper liners and set aside.
Toast the Pecans: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons of the butter. Add the chopped pecans and toast them for about 45 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent burning. Once toasted, remove from heat and let them cool.
Mix the Batter: In a large mixing bowl, cream together the remaining 1 cup of softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in the vanilla extract.
Combine Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, cake flour, baking powder, salt, and ground cinnamon.
Incorporate Dry Ingredients and Milk: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture, alternating with the whole milk. Begin and end with the dry ingredients, mixing just until combined.
Fold in Pecans: Gently fold the toasted pecans into the batter until evenly distributed.
Fill and Bake: Divide the batter evenly among the cupcake liners, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake in the preheated oven for 2123 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cupcakes to cool completely on a wire rack before frosting.
Prepare the Frosting: In a mixing bowl, beat together the cream cheese and butter until smooth and creamy. Add the dark brown sugar and ground cinnamon, beating for an additional 34 minutes until fully incorporated. Gradually add the powdered sugar, one cup at a time, mixing until the frosting reaches your desired consistency.
Frost the Cupcakes: Once the cupcakes have cooled completely, pipe or spread the brown sugar cream cheese frosting onto each one.
Garnish: Sprinkle the frosted cupcakes with the toasted and chopped pecans for added flavor and texture.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 30 minutes  Cooking Time: 23 minutes  Total Time: 53 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 306 kcal per cupcake
 Servings: 24 cupcakes

1 cup pecan halves
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 tablespoon butter
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
Pinch of salt
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Set your oven to 350F 175C.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper for easy cleanup and to prevent sticking.
Prepare the Sugar Coating:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter and sugar together.
Stir continuously until the sugar is fully dissolved.

Message:
Saltine Toffee Recipe 
Ingredients:
4 ounces saltine crackers about 3540 crackers
1 cup unsalted butter
1 cup dark brown sugar
2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
 cup chopped pecans
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 400F 200C.
Prepare the Baking Sheet:
Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper or foil for easy cleanup. Arrange the saltine crackers in a single layer, covering the entire surface.
Make the Toffee Mixture:
In a saucepan, combine the butter and dark brown sugar.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Let it boil for 3 minutes without stirring, ensuring a smooth caramel.
Pour the Toffee:
Immediately pour the hot toffee mixture over the saltine crackers, spreading it evenly with a spatula to cover all the crackers.
Bake the Toffee:
Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake for 56 minutes, or until the caramel is bubbling and golden.
Add the Chocolate:
Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Sprinkle the semisweet chocolate chips over the hot toffee.
Let the chocolate sit for 5 minutes to melt, then spread it evenly over the caramel layer using a spatula.
Top with Pecans:
Sprinkle the chopped pecans over the melted chocolate for added flavor and crunch.
Cool and Break:
Allow the toffee to cool completely at room temperature, about 25 minutes. For faster cooling, place it in the refrigerator.
Once cooled, break the toffee into irregular pieces.
Enjoy this addictive, sweet-and-salty treat thats perfect for parties, gifts, or anytime snacking!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Cooling Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 45 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 120 kcal per piece   Servings: 2025 pieces

Long Island Iced Coffee 
A rich and creamy coffee cocktail with a boozy twist, perfect for relaxing evenings or weekend brunches. This flavorful mix is sure to be a hit!
Ingredients:
1 oz Baileys Irish Cream
1 oz Kahlúa
 oz tequila
 oz vodka
4 oz cold brew coffee
1 oz whipping cream
Ice 流
Whipped cream and coffee beans optional, for garnish
Directions:
Prepare the Glass:
Fill a highball glass or large rocks glass with ice.
Mix the Drink:
In a cocktail shaker, combine the Baileys Irish Cream, Kahlúa, tequila, vodka, and cold brew coffee.
Add a handful of ice to the shaker and shake vigorously until well chilled.
Serve:
Strain the chilled mixture into the prepared glass over ice.
Add the Cream:
Slowly pour the whipping cream over the top of the drink. Gently stir to combine for a creamy finish.
Garnish and Enjoy:
Garnish with a dollop of whipped cream and a few coffee beans for an elegant touch, if desired.
Sip and savor the rich, indulgent flavors of this boozy iced coffee!

 Servings: 1 cocktail

Message:
樂 No-Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Cheesecake 樂
A decadent and creamy dessert with layers of chocolate and peanut butter cheesecake atop a buttery graham cracker crust. This easy no-bake treat is perfect for peanut butter and chocolate lovers alike!
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1  cups graham cracker crumbs 150 g
 cup sugar 50 g
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 85 g
For the Peanut Butter Cheesecake Layer:
16 oz cream cheese 450 g, softened
1 cup peanut butter 250 g, creamy
1 cup powdered sugar 120 g
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup heavy cream 240 mL, whipped to stiff peaks
For the Chocolate Cheesecake Layer:
8 oz cream cheese 225 g, softened
1 cup heavy cream 240 mL, whipped to stiff peaks
 cup powdered sugar 60 g
 cup cocoa powder 30 g
 cup chocolate chips 90 g, melted
For Garnish: Optional
Chopped peanuts
Chocolate syrup
Peanut butter drizzle
Mini chocolate chips
Directions:
Prepare the Crust:
Combine the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter in a bowl. Mix until the crumbs are evenly coated.
Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch 23 cm springform pan or pie dish.
Chill the crust in the refrigerator for 1015 minutes to set.
Make the Peanut Butter Cheesecake Layer:
In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and peanut butter until smooth.
Add the powdered sugar and vanilla extract, beating until creamy.
Gently fold in the whipped heavy cream until well incorporated.
Spread the peanut butter cheesecake mixture evenly over the prepared crust.
Refrigerate while preparing the chocolate layer.
Make the Chocolate Cheesecake Layer:
In another bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add the powdered sugar, cocoa powder, and melted chocolate. Beat until fully combined and smooth.
Gently fold in the whipped heavy cream.
Spread the chocolate cheesecake layer evenly over the peanut butter layer, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Chill and Set:
Refrigerate the cheesecake for 46 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow it to set completely.
Garnish and Serve:
Before serving, garnish the cheesecake with chopped peanuts, chocolate syrup, peanut butter drizzle, and mini chocolate chips if desired.
Slice and serve chilled.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 30 minutes  Chill Time: 46 hours  Total Time: 6 hours 30 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 420 kcal per slice   Servings: 12 slices

Message:
樂 Peanut Butter Sandwich Cookies 樂
These delightful cookies feature soft, chewy peanut butter cookies sandwiched with a rich and creamy peanut butter filling. A perfect treat for peanut butter lovers!
Ingredients:
For the Cookies:
1  cups all-purpose flour
 teaspoon baking soda
 teaspoon salt
 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup peanut butter
 cup granulated sugar
 cup brown sugar, packed
1 large egg
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
For the Filling:
 cup creamy peanut butter
1  cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Mix Dry Ingredients:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
Prepare the Cookie Dough:
In a large bowl, beat together the softened butter, peanut butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth and creamy.
Add the egg and vanilla extract, and mix until fully combined.
Combine Wet and Dry Mixtures:
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing just until combined.
Shape the Cookies:
Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough and roll them into balls. Place the balls onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Flatten each ball slightly with a fork, pressing in a criss-cross pattern on top.
Bake the Cookies:
Bake in the preheated oven for 1012 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Prepare the Filling:
In a bowl, beat together the peanut butter, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and softened butter until smooth and creamy.
Assemble the Sandwich Cookies:
Once the cookies are completely cooled, spread a generous amount of filling on the flat side of one cookie.
Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich. Repeat with the remaining cookies and filling.
Serve and Store:
Store the sandwich cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to a week.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 1012 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 180 kcal per cookie   Servings: 12 sandwich cookies

Message:
Homemade Caramels 
Ingredients:
1 cup 227g unsalted butter
1 cup 200g granulated sugar
1 cup 220g packed brown sugar
1 cup 240ml light corn syrup
1 can 12 oz or 354ml evaporated milk
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/4 teaspoon salt
Directions:
Prepare the Pan: Line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper, allowing the edges to overhang for easy removal. Lightly grease the parchment paper with butter or non-stick spray.
Combine Ingredients: In a large, heavy-bottomed saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the granulated sugar, brown sugar, light corn syrup, and salt. Stir continuously until the mixture begins to boil.
Add Evaporated Milk: Gradually pour in the evaporated milk, ensuring the mixture maintains a steady boil. Continue stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Cook to Temperature: Attach a candy thermometer to the side of the saucepan, ensuring it doesnt touch the bottom. Continue cooking and stirring the mixture until it reaches 238F 114C, known as the soft-ball stage. This process may take approximately 10-15 minutes.
Add Vanilla: Once the desired temperature is reached, remove the saucepan from heat. Stir in the vanilla extract until fully incorporated.
Pour and Cool: Carefully pour the hot caramel into the prepared baking dish, spreading it evenly. Allow it to cool at room temperature until set, which may take several hours.
Cut and Wrap: Once fully cooled and set, lift the caramel slab out of the pan using the parchment overhang. Place it on a cutting board and use a sharp knife to cut into desired shapes and sizes. For storage, wrap individual caramels in wax paper or cellophane to prevent sticking.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes
 Cooking Time: 30 minutes
 Total Time: 40 minutes plus cooling time
 Calories: Approximately 70 kcal per piece
 Servings: About 60 pieces
#HomemadeCaramels #CandyMaking #SweetTreats #CaramelLovers #DessertRecipes

Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1  cups all-purpose flour
 cup unsalted butter, softened
 cup granulated sugar
 teaspoon vanilla extract
For the Cheesecake Filling:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon lime zest
1 tablespoon lime juice
For the Toppings:
1 cup blueberry preserves
1 cup fresh blueberries
 cup purple-tinted cream cheese frosting
Lime slices and zest for garnish
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a muffin tin with paper liners.
Prepare the Crust:
In a mixing bowl, combine the flour, softened butter, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract.
Mix until the mixture forms a soft dough.
Press about 1 tablespoon of dough evenly into the bottom of each muffin cup.
Bake for 10 minutes, or until the crusts are lightly golden. Allow to cool completely.
Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In another bowl, beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar, lime zest, and lime juice until smooth and creamy.
Assemble the Cupcakes:
Spoon a layer of blueberry preserves over the cooled crust in each muffin cup.
Pipe the cream cheese mixture over the blueberry layer, filling each cup nearly to the top.
Add a spoonful of the remaining blueberry preserves on top of the cream cheese layer.
Add the Frosting and Garnishes:
Top each cupcake with a swirl of purple-tinted cream cheese frosting.
Garnish with fresh blueberries, lime slices, and a sprinkle of lime zest for a bright, decorative finish.
Chill and Serve:
Refrigerate the cupcakes for at least 1 hour before serving to allow the flavors to meld and the cheesecake filling to set.

 cup purple-tinted cream cheese frosting

Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a muffin tin with paper liners.

Press about 1 tablespoon of dough evenly into the bottom of each muffin cup.

Message:
李 Carrot Cheesecake Stuffed Cookies 李
These soft, spiced cookies are packed with finely shredded carrots and feature a creamy cheesecake filling  a delightful twist on carrot cake in cookie form!
Ingredients:
For the Cookie Dough:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
1 cup brown sugar, packed
2 large eggs
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
2  cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
 teaspoon salt
1 cup finely shredded carrots
For the Cheesecake Filling:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
Prepare the Oven and Baking Sheet:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper to prevent sticking.
Make the Cookie Dough:
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy about 23 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Gently fold in the shredded carrots.
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In another bowl, mix the softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy.
Assemble the Stuffed Cookies:
Scoop out a tablespoon of cookie dough and flatten it slightly in your hand.
Place a small spoonful of the cream cheese mixture in the center.
Top with another tablespoon of cookie dough, sealing the edges to enclose the filling completely.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Bake the Cookies:
Place the filled cookies onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 1215 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Enjoy these irresistible stuffed cookies with their perfect blend of spiced carrot cookie and creamy cheesecake center!

Message:
Mouth-watering Reeses Peanut Butter Cup Cheesecake 燎
This decadent cheesecake combines the creamy richness of peanut butter and cream cheese with the irresistible chocolatey goodness of Reeses. A perfect dessert for peanut butter lovers!
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1  cups chocolate cookie crumbs
 cup melted butter
For the Cheesecake Filling:
3 8 oz packages cream cheese, softened
1 cup sugar
1 cup sour cream
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
3 large eggs
1 cup creamy peanut butter
1520 Reeses peanut butter cups, chopped
For the Topping:
1 cup heavy cream
 cup chocolate chips
 cup peanut butter chips
Caramel sauce for drizzling
Whipped cream optional, for garnish
Directions:
Prepare the Crust:
Preheat the oven to 325F 163C.
In a medium bowl, combine the chocolate cookie crumbs and melted butter.
Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan to form an even crust. Set aside.
Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until smooth and creamy.
Add the sour cream and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.
Stir in the peanut butter until the mixture is smooth and evenly combined.
Add Reeses:
Gently fold in half of the chopped Reeses peanut butter cups into the cheesecake batter.
Pour the batter over the prepared crust, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Bake the Cheesecake:
Bake for 5560 minutes, or until the center is set and the edges are lightly browned.
Turn off the oven and leave the cheesecake inside with the door slightly ajar to cool for 1 hour.
Cool and Chill:
Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool completely at room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to set fully.
Prepare the Ganache Topping:
In a small saucepan, heat the heavy cream over medium heat until it begins to simmer.
Remove from heat and stir in the chocolate chips until melted and smooth. Let the ganache cool slightly.
Decorate:
Drizzle the cooled ganache over the chilled cheesecake.
Top with the remaining chopped Reeses peanut butter cups, peanut butter chips, and a drizzle of caramel sauce.
Add whipped cream if desired for an extra indulgent touch.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 30 minutes  Cooking Time: 60 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 450 kcal per slice   Servings: 12 slices

Message:
Irresistible Banana Walnut Dream Cake 
Ingredients:
3 cups all-purpose flour
1  teaspoons baking soda
 teaspoon salt
1 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
1  cups granulated sugar
 cup brown sugar, packed
3 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup sour cream
4 ripe bananas, mashed
1 cup walnuts, chopped
For Garnish:
1  cups cream cheese frosting
 cup banana slices
 cup walnuts, chopped
Directions:
Prepare the Pans:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour three 9-inch round cake pans to prevent sticking.
Mix Dry Ingredients:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
Cream Butter and Sugars:
In a large mixing bowl, beat the butter until creamy. Gradually add the granulated sugar and brown sugar, beating until light and fluffy about 34 minutes.
Add Eggs and Vanilla:
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter mixture in three parts, alternating with the sour cream. Begin and end with the flour mixture, mixing just until combined.
Incorporate Bananas and Walnuts:
Gently fold in the mashed bananas and chopped walnuts until evenly distributed.
Bake the Layers:
Divide the batter evenly among the prepared pans. Smooth the tops with a spatula.
Bake for 2530 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool the Cakes:
Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 10 minutes. Turn them out onto wire racks and let them cool completely before frosting.
Frost the Cake:
Spread cream cheese frosting between the layers, then over the top and sides of the cake.
Garnish and Serve:
Garnish with banana slices and additional chopped walnuts for an elegant finish. Slice and enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 50 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 slices

Message:
French Salted Log with Sea Flavors: Crab, Smoked Salmon & Shrimp 
A festive and savory delight, this salted log combines the delicate flavors of crab, smoked salmon, and shrimp, enhanced by creamy cheese and a hint of lemon zest. Perfect as a show-stopping appetizer for holiday gatherings or special occasions!
Ingredients:
200g crab meat fresh or canned, well-drained
150g smoked salmon cut into small pieces
6 peeled prawns for decoration
250g fresh cheese mascarpone or Philadelphia type
3 eggs separated into yolks and whites
1 tablespoon mustard
10 cl 100 ml liquid cream
Zest of 1 lemon plus wedges for garnish
1 tablespoon chopped chives or dill, based on preference
Salt and pepper to taste
Directions:
Prepare the Egg Base:
Preheat the oven to 180C 350F. Grease a log mold or rectangular pan and line it with parchment paper.
Separate the egg yolks and whites into two bowls.
Create the Mixture:
In the bowl with the yolks, add the fresh cheese, mustard, and liquid cream. Whip the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the whites into the yolk mixture using a spatula, being careful to maintain the airy texture.
Incorporate the Sea Ingredients:
Add the crab meat and smoked salmon pieces to the mixture. Stir gently to combine without deflating the egg whites.
Assemble and Bake:
Pour the mixture into the prepared log mold, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Bake for about 30 minutes, or until the log is golden and firm to the touch.
Cool and Set:
Once baked, remove the log from the oven and allow it to cool completely in the mold to ensure it sets properly.
Decorate and Serve:
Carefully unmold the cooled log onto a serving plate.
Arrange the peeled shrimp on top for decoration. Add lemon wedges around the plate and sprinkle with chopped chives or dill for freshness and color.
Enjoy this elegant, seafood-infused log as a sophisticated appetizer or centerpiece for your next festive gathering!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 45 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 250 kcal per serving   Servings: 68 slices
#SeafoodLog #SavoryDelights #HolidayAppetizer #CrabAndSalmon #ElegantStarters

Message:
White Chocolate Pineapple Pecan Cheesecake 
Ingredients:
1  cups graham cracker crumbs
 cup melted butter
24 oz cream cheese, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
3 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup crushed pineapple, drained
1 cup chopped pecans
 cup white chocolate, melted
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 325F 160C. Grease a 9-inch springform pan and set aside.
Prepare the Crust:
In a medium bowl, mix the graham cracker crumbs and melted butter until evenly combined.
Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of the prepared springform pan to form an even crust. Set aside.
Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and granulated sugar together until smooth and creamy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Add the Pineapple and Pecans:
Gently fold in the drained crushed pineapple and chopped pecans until evenly distributed throughout the filling.
Assemble the Cheesecake:
Pour the cream cheese mixture over the crust in the prepared pan. Spread it evenly with a spatula.
Bake:
Bake in the preheated oven for 6070 minutes, or until the center is set and the top is lightly browned.
Cool and Chill:
Turn off the oven and leave the cheesecake inside with the door slightly ajar for 1 hour to cool gradually.
Once cooled, refrigerate the cheesecake for at least 4 hours or overnight to set fully.
Decorate and Serve:
Before serving, drizzle the melted white chocolate over the top of the cheesecake.
Sprinkle with additional chopped pecans for an extra crunch and garnish.
Enjoy this creamy, tropical dessert with its nutty, chocolaty finish  its sure to impress!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 70 minutes  Total Time: 5 hours including cooling and refrigeration
 Kcal: Approximately 450 kcal per slice   Servings: 12 slices

Message:
Mouthwatering Lemon Blueberry Cupcakes 
These cupcakes are bursting with the zesty flavor of lemon and the sweetness of blueberries, topped with a luscious lemon cream cheese frosting and a delicate drizzle. Perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients:
For the Cupcakes:
1  cups all-purpose flour
1  teaspoons baking powder
 teaspoon salt
 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 cup milk
Zest of 1 lemon
1 cup fresh blueberries
For the Lemon Cream Cheese Frosting:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Juice and zest of 1 lemon
For the Lemon Drizzle:
2 tablespoons lemon juice
 cup powdered sugar
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a 12-cup cupcake pan with cupcake liners.
Prepare the Dry Ingredients:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
Cream the Butter and Sugar:
In a large bowl, beat the butter and granulated sugar together until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in the vanilla extract and lemon zest.
Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture, alternating with milk. Begin and end with the dry ingredients, mixing just until combined.
Gently fold in the fresh blueberries.
Bake the Cupcakes:
Spoon the batter into the cupcake liners, filling each about  full.
Bake for 1820 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cupcakes to cool completely on a wire rack.
Make the Lemon Cream Cheese Frosting:
Beat the cream cheese and butter together until smooth and creamy.
Gradually add the powdered sugar, mixing until well incorporated.
Mix in the vanilla extract, lemon juice, and lemon zest until the frosting is smooth and fluffy.
Frost the Cupcakes:
Spread or pipe the frosting onto the cooled cupcakes.
Prepare the Lemon Drizzle:
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and powdered sugar until smooth.
Drizzle the mixture over the frosted cupcakes.
Garnish:
Add additional blueberries or a sprinkle of lemon zest on top for an elegant finish, if desired.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 280 kcal per cupcake   Servings: 12 cupcakes

Message:
No-Bake Peppermint Bark Snowballs 
These rich, chocolaty snowballs with a refreshing peppermint crunch are a perfect no-bake holiday treat. Festive and easy to make, theyre sure to delight at any gathering!
Ingredients:
Baking & Spices:
2 cups crushed chocolate wafer cookies or chocolate graham crackers
 cup powdered sugar
 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
 teaspoon peppermint extract
Dairy:
 cup unsalted butter, melted
Toppings:
1 cup white chocolate chips or chopped white chocolate
 cup crushed candy canes or peppermint candies
Directions:
Combine Dry Ingredients:
In a large mixing bowl, combine the crushed chocolate wafer cookies, powdered sugar, and cocoa powder. Mix until well combined.
Add Wet Ingredients:
Stir in the melted butter and peppermint extract. Mix until the ingredients come together into a moist, cohesive mixture.
Shape the Snowballs:
Scoop about 1 tablespoon of the mixture and roll it into a small ball between your palms.
Place the rolled snowballs onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining mixture.
Chill the Snowballs:
Refrigerate the snowballs for about 30 minutes, or until they are firm and easy to handle.
Melt the White Chocolate:

Message:
Sweet Potato Cheesecake Stuffed Cookies 
A perfect blend of warm spices, creamy cheesecake, and the comforting sweetness of sweet potato  these stuffed cookies are a delightful fall-inspired treat!
Ingredients:
For the Sweet Potato Cheesecake Filling:
 cup cooked sweet potato, mashed about 1 medium sweet potato
8 oz cream cheese, softened
 cup powdered sugar
 teaspoon ground cinnamon
 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 tablespoon heavy cream optional, for smoother texture
For the Cookie Dough:
1  cups all-purpose flour
 teaspoon baking soda
 teaspoon ground cinnamon
 teaspoon ground nutmeg
 teaspoon salt
 cup unsalted butter, softened
 cup granulated sugar
 cup brown sugar, packed
1 large egg
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Make the Sweet Potato Cheesecake Filling:
In a medium bowl, mix the mashed sweet potato, cream cheese, powdered sugar, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and heavy cream if using until smooth and creamy.
Cover and refrigerate the filling while you prepare the cookie dough.
Prepare the Cookie Dough:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
In a large bowl, cream the butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy about 23 minutes.
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until fully incorporated.
Gradually mix the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until a soft dough forms.
Assemble the Stuffed Cookies:
Take a tablespoon of cookie dough and flatten it slightly in your hands.
Add 12 teaspoons of the sweet potato cheesecake filling to the center of the dough.
Flatten another tablespoon of dough and place it over the filling, sealing the edges to encase the filling completely.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Bake the Cookies:
Place the stuffed cookie dough balls on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 1012 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown. Avoid overbaking to keep the cookies soft.
Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Serve:
Once cooled, serve and enjoy the rich, spiced cookies filled with a creamy, sweet potato cheesecake center. They pair perfectly with a warm cup of tea or coffee!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cook Time: 12 minutes  Total Time: 32 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 180 kcal per cookie   Servings: About 18 cookies

Message:
Cheesecake Egg Rolls with Caramel Sauce 
Ingredients:
For the egg rolls:
8 large egg roll wrappers
8 oz cream cheese, softened
 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 cup sour cream
 cup mini chocolate chips optional
 cup cinnamon sugar for coating
Oil for frying vegetable oil or canola oil
For the caramel sauce:
 cup brown sugar
 cup heavy cream
2 tablespoons butter
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In a mixing bowl, combine softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and sour cream.
Mix until smooth and creamy.
If desired, fold in mini chocolate chips for added flavor and texture.
Assemble the Egg Rolls:
Lay an egg roll wrapper on a clean surface with one corner facing you like a diamond shape.
Place 23 tablespoons of the cheesecake filling in the center.
Fold the bottom corner over the filling, then fold in the sides, and roll tightly. Seal the edge with a little water to secure the roll.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Fry the Egg Rolls:
Heat oil in a deep pan or skillet over medium-high heat about 350F or 175C.
Carefully place the egg rolls into the hot oil, frying a few at a time to avoid overcrowding.
Fry for 23 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy, flipping occasionally for even cooking.
Remove the egg rolls and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Coat the Egg Rolls:
While the egg rolls are still warm, roll them in the cinnamon sugar mixture until fully coated.
Prepare the Caramel Sauce:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine brown sugar, heavy cream, and butter.
Stir occasionally until the sugar dissolves and the sauce thickens, about 35 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract.
Serve:
Serve the warm cheesecake egg rolls with the caramel sauce for dipping. Enjoy the crispy, creamy, and sweet treat!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 200 kcal per egg roll   Servings: 8 egg rolls

Message:
Grandmas Irresistibly Soft Molasses Cookies 
Warm, spiced, and irresistibly soft, these cookies are the perfect treat to brighten any cozy afternoon. Each bite is full of the rich flavors of molasses, ginger, and cinnamon  truly a timeless classic!
Ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons baking soda
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
 teaspoon ground ginger
 teaspoon ground cloves
 teaspoon salt
 cup vegetable oil
1 cup granulated sugar plus extra for rolling
 cup full-flavor molasses
1 large egg room temperature
Instructions:
Prepare the Dry Ingredients:
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, and salt. Set aside.
Mix the Wet Ingredients:
In another bowl, mix the vegetable oil and sugar until well combined.
Stir in the molasses and egg, blending thoroughly.
Combine the Mixtures:
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients. Mix until just combined, taking care not to overmix the dough.
Chill the Dough:
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Chilling the dough makes it easier to handle and enhances the cookies softness.
Preheat the Oven:
When ready to bake, preheat your oven to 375F 190C.
Line two baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats.
Shape the Cookies:
Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough and roll into 1-inch balls.
Roll each ball in granulated sugar for a sparkly finish.
Bake:
Arrange the dough balls 2 inches apart on the prepared baking sheets.
Bake for 810 minutes, or until the edges are set but the centers remain soft.
Cool and Enjoy:
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. The cookies will flatten slightly as they cool, achieving that perfect soft texture.
Customizable Notes:
Sugar Swap: Use organic cane sugar for a natural touch.
Molasses Options: Light or dark molasses works well, but avoid blackstrap molasses as its less sweet.
Extra Spice: Add a pinch of nutmeg or extra cinnamon for a spicier flavor.
Gluten-Free: Use a gluten-free baking blend as a substitute for the all-purpose flour.
Details:
 Servings: Makes about 36 cookies
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cook Time: 10 minutes  Chill Time: 2 hours  Total Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
 Nutrition per cookie: Approx. 96 calories  13g carbohydrates  5g fat  1g protein
These cookies pair beautifully with a cup of tea or coffee, making them the ultimate comfort treat. Happy baking, and enjoy every deliciously soft and chewy bite!
#MolassesCookies #SoftAndChewy #CozyBaking #TimelessRecipes #SweetTreats

Message:
Steak and Seafood Skillet with Garlic Parmesan Cream Sauce 龍數
Ingredients:
1.5 pounds ribeye steak or cut of choice
1 pound jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 tablespoons unsalted butter
1.5 teaspoons kosher salt adjust to taste
 teaspoon black pepper adjust to taste
 teaspoon red pepper flakes optional
 teaspoon smoked paprika
1 medium onion, diced
6 cloves garlic, minced
8 ounces fresh spinach, chopped
1 medium lemon zested and juiced
 cup broth beef, chicken, seafood, or vegetable
1 cup heavy whipping cream
4 ounces freshly grated Parmesan cheese
Fresh parsley and additional Parmesan cheese for garnish
Instructions:
Sear the Steak:
Season the steak with kosher salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 34 minutes per side for medium-rare or adjust based on your preferred doneness.
Remove from the skillet, cover lightly with foil, and let it rest.
Cook the Shrimp:
Using the same skillet, add the butter and let it melt over medium heat.
Add the shrimp and sear until pink and fully cooked, about 2 minutes per side.
Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Sauté Onions and Garlic:
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet. Cook until softened and fragrant, about 34 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Make the Sauce:
Pour in the broth, lemon juice, and lemon zest, stirring to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and stir in the heavy whipping cream and Parmesan cheese.
Let the sauce simmer gently for 23 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until wilted.
Combine and Serve:
Return the steak and shrimp to the skillet, tossing them gently in the creamy sauce to coat.
Garnish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan cheese.
Serve Hot:
Plate the steak and shrimp with the sauce spooned over the top. Pair with crusty bread, mashed potatoes, or steamed vegetables for a luxurious meal.
Enjoy this indulgent and flavorful dish thats perfect for a special dinner or date night!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 550 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings

Message:
龍復 Cheddar Cauliflower and Roasted Garlic Soup 龍復
Ingredients:
1 head of cauliflower, chopped into florets
1 bulb of garlic, roasted see instructions below
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 onion, diced
4 cups vegetable broth
1 cup milk or cream for a richer soup
2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
Salt and pepper, to taste
Fresh parsley or chives optional, for garnish
Directions:
Roast the Garlic:
Preheat your oven to 400F 200C.
Slice off the top of the garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and wrap the bulb in foil.
Roast for 3035 minutes, or until the garlic is soft and caramelized. Let it cool, then squeeze the roasted cloves out of their skins. Set aside.
Sauté the Onion:
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté for 57 minutes until softened and translucent.
Cook the Cauliflower:
Add the chopped cauliflower to the pot and stir to combine. Cook for about 5 minutes to let it soften slightly.
Add Broth and Simmer:
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 1520 minutes, or until the cauliflower is very tender.
Blend the Soup:
Remove the pot from heat. Use an immersion blender to purée the soup until smooth and creamy. Alternatively, purée the soup in batches using a blender.
Incorporate Roasted Garlic and Cream:
Add the roasted garlic cloves to the soup and blend them in. Stir in the milk or cream, and bring the soup back to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the Cheese:
Gradually stir in the shredded cheddar cheese, allowing it to melt into the soup. Mix until the soup is smooth and creamy. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve:
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley or chives, if desired. Pair with warm crusty bread or crackers for a comforting meal.
Enjoy the perfect balance of cheesy, creamy goodness with the earthy, rich flavor of roasted garlic and cauliflower in every spoonful!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 40 minutes  Total Time: 55 minutes
 Kcal: Approximately 250 kcal per serving   Servings: 46 servings

Message:
Lemon Crinkle Cookies 
Ingredients:
2  cups all-purpose flour
1  teaspoons baking powder
 teaspoon baking soda
 teaspoon salt
 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 tablespoon lemon zest
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 cup powdered sugar for rolling
Directions:
Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and line baking sheets with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
Cream Butter and Sugar: In a large mixing bowl, use a hand or stand mixer to cream the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
Incorporate Wet Ingredients: Beat in the eggs one at a time, ensuring each is fully combined. Add the lemon zest, fresh lemon juice, and vanilla extract, mixing until smooth.
Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture. Mix just until combined to form a soft dough.
Chill the Dough: Cover the dough and chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to make it easier to handle.
Shape the Cookies: Roll the chilled dough into 1-inch balls. Roll each ball generously in powdered sugar to coat.
Arrange on Baking Sheets: Place the powdered sugar-coated dough balls on the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake: Bake in the preheated oven for 810 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers remain slightly soft. Avoid overbaking for the perfect chewy texture.
Cool and Serve: Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring them to wire racks to cool completely. Enjoy their bright, zesty flavor!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 55 minutes including chilling
 Kcal: 120 kcal per cookie   Servings: 24 cookies

Message:
Cranberry Feta Pinwheels with Cream Cheese 
Ingredients:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 cup crumbled feta cheese
1 cup dried cranberries
1/4 cup chopped green onions
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/4 tsp black pepper
4 large flour tortillas 8-10 inches
1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley optional, for garnish
Directions:
Prepare the Filling:
In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, crumbled feta cheese, dried cranberries, chopped green onions, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Mix well until the ingredients are evenly combined.
Spread the Filling:
Lay a tortilla flat on a clean surface.
Spread a generous layer of the cream cheese mixture evenly over the tortilla, leaving a small border around the edges to prevent overflow.
Roll the Tortillas:
Roll the tortilla tightly from one end to the other, pressing gently to secure the roll.
Repeat this process with the remaining tortillas and filling.
Chill the Rolls:
Place the rolled tortillas in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to firm up. This helps with slicing and enhances the flavors.
Slice into Pinwheels:
After chilling, use a sharp knife to slice each roll into 1-inch pinwheels.
Serve and Garnish:
Arrange the pinwheels on a serving platter.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley for garnish, if desired.
Serving Suggestions:
These Cranberry Feta Pinwheels make a festive appetizer for holiday gatherings, potlucks, or as a quick and flavorful snack.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes
 Chill Time: 30 minutes
 Total Time: 45 minutes
 Servings: Approximately 24 pinwheels
#CranberryFetaPinwheels #HolidayAppetizers #EasySnacks #FestiveRecipes #PartyFavorites

Message:
Frostbite Blue Christmas Cocoa 
Ingredients:
For the Cocoa Base:
3 cups whole milk or your preferred milk
1 cup heavy cream for a rich and creamy texture
1 cup white chocolate chips or chopped white chocolate
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
A few drops of blue food coloring to create the blue hue
Pinch of salt to enhance sweetness
For the Toppings Optional:
Whipped cream
Blue sprinkles or edible glitter
Mini marshmallows
Shaved white chocolate or white chocolate chips
Blueberries or blue candy canes
Instructions:
Make the Cocoa Base:
In a medium saucepan, combine the milk and heavy cream.
Heat over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is warm but not boiling.
Melt the Chocolate:
Add the white chocolate chips to the saucepan.
Stir continuously until the chocolate is fully melted and the cocoa is smooth and creamy.
Enhance the Flavor:
Stir in the vanilla extract and a pinch of salt to enhance the sweetness.
Add the Blue Hue:
Add a few drops of blue food coloring to the cocoa.
Stir well until the color is evenly distributed and reaches your desired shade of frosty blue.
Pour and Garnish:
Pour the cocoa into mugs or clear glass cups to show off the vibrant blue color.
Top with whipped cream and decorate with blue sprinkles, edible glitter, or mini marshmallows.
Optional Extras:
For an added festive touch, garnish with shaved white chocolate, blueberries, or a small blue candy cane.
Serving Tip:
Serve this Frostbite Blue Christmas Cocoa at winter gatherings or cozy nights in. The creamy texture and unique blue color make it a memorable holiday treat for kids and adults alike!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 5 minutes
 Cook Time: 10 minutes
 Total Time: 15 minutes
 Servings: 4 mugs
#BlueChristmasCocoa #HolidayDrinks #FestiveRecipes #WinterTreats #HotChocolateDelights

Message:
燎 Cinnamon Kissed Cheesecake Donut Cookies 燎
Ingredients:
For the Dough:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 cups all-purpose flour
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
For the Cheesecake Filling:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
For the Cinnamon Sugar Coating:
1 cup granulated sugar
1 tbsp ground cinnamon
For the Caramel Sauce optional:
1 cup caramel sauce
Directions:
Prepare the Dough:
In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Mix in the vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In a medium bowl, beat the cream cheese, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy.
Transfer the mixture to a piping bag for easy filling.
Shape the Cookies:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll the dough into 1-inch balls. Flatten each ball slightly and use a large cookie cutter to shape them into circles.

Message:
燎 Walking Taco Bake 燎
Ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 package taco seasoning
2/3 cup water
Chili cheese Fritos enough to cover the bottom of an 8x8 baking dish
1/2 can cheddar cheese soup
1/4 cup milk
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
Directions:
Cook the Meat:
In a skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef until fully cooked and no longer pink.
Drain any excess fat, then add the taco seasoning and water.
Simmer on low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is absorbed and the meat is evenly coated with seasoning.
Prepare the Baking Dish:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
Layer enough chili cheese Fritos to cover the bottom of an 8x8-inch baking dish.
Spread the seasoned ground beef evenly over the Fritos.
Make the Cheese Sauce:
In a small saucepan over low heat, combine the cheddar cheese soup and milk.
Stir occasionally until the mixture is smooth and warmed through.
Pour the cheese sauce evenly over the beef layer in the dish.
Bake the Dish:
Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese evenly over the top.
Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for 12-14 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve:
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Scoop portions onto plates and enjoy this fun and flavorful twist on a taco!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes
 Cook Time: 20 minutes
 Total Time: 30 minutes
 Servings: 4

Message:
塞 Chinese Chicken Cabbage Stir-Fry 塞
Ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken breast, sliced into thin strips
1 small Chinese cabbage, chopped into bite-sized pieces
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 inch ginger, peeled and grated
2 tbsp vegetable oil
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tsp cornstarch
1/4 cup water
Salt and pepper, to taste
Directions:
Prepare the Sauce:
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornstarch, and water. Set aside.
Heat the Wok:
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Cook the Chicken:
Add the chicken strips to the wok. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until the chicken is browned and nearly cooked through.
Add the Cabbage:
Toss in the chopped Chinese cabbage. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the cabbage is slightly wilted but still crisp.
Add the Sauce:
Pour the prepared sauce into the wok. Stir-fry for about 1 minute, allowing the sauce to thicken and coat the chicken and cabbage evenly.
Season and Serve:
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot over steamed rice for a complete meal. Enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes
 Cooking Time: 10 minutes
 Total Time: 20 minutes
 Servings: 4

Message:
旅燎 Baked Cranberry Turkey Sliders 燎旅
Ingredients:
12 slider buns
1 1/2 cups leftover turkey, sliced or shredded
1 cup cranberry sauce
6-8 slices Havarti cheese
1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp poppy seeds
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking dish with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
Assemble the Sliders:
Place the bottom halves of the slider buns into the prepared baking dish.
Layer with turkey, followed by cranberry sauce and Havarti cheese slices.
Top with the remaining slider bun halves.
Prepare the Butter Topping:
In a small bowl, whisk together the melted butter, Dijon mustard, poppy seeds, and Worcestershire sauce.
Brush and Bake:
Brush the butter mixture generously over the tops of the sliders.
Cover the dish with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Serve:
Serve the sliders warm, straight from the oven. Enjoy these sweet, savory, and cheesy bites perfect for gatherings or a quick meal!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes
 Cooking Time: 20-25 minutes
 Total Time: 30-35 minutes
 Servings: 12 sliders

Message:
Banana Fudge 
Ingredients:
3 ripe bananas, mashed
2 cups granulated sugar
1/2 cup unsalted butter
1 can 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup white chocolate chips optional
1 cup chopped nuts optional
Directions:
Combine Ingredients:
In a large saucepan, add the mashed bananas, granulated sugar, unsalted butter, and sweetened condensed milk.
Cook the Mixture:
Place the saucepan over medium heat and stir constantly as the mixture comes to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture thickens and becomes glossy.
Add Vanilla and Optional Ingredients:
Remove the saucepan from the heat.
Stir in the vanilla extract.
If desired, fold in the white chocolate chips and chopped nuts for added texture and flavor.
Pour and Set:
Pour the fudge mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking pan, spreading it evenly with a spatula.
Let the fudge cool completely at room temperature, or place it in the refrigerator to firm up more quickly.
Cut and Serve:
Once set, cut the fudge into squares and serve. Enjoy your creamy and decadent banana fudge!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes
 Cook Time: 15 minutes
 Cooling Time: 1-2 hours
 Servings: 24 squares
Tips:
For extra flavor, try adding a pinch of cinnamon or nutmeg to the banana mixture during cooking.
Store fudge in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week.
#BananaFudge #HomemadeTreats #DessertRecipes #EasyDesserts #SweetAndCreamy

縷燎 Baked Chicken Ham and Cheese Croissants 燎縷
Ingredients:
6 large croissants, sliced in half
12 slices deli chicken ham
6 slices Swiss or cheddar cheese
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1/4 cup melted butter
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp poppy seeds optional
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
Assemble the Croissants:
Spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard on the cut side of the bottom half of each croissant.
Layer 2 slices of chicken ham and 1 slice of Swiss or cheddar cheese on top.
Place the top half of the croissant over the fillings.
Prepare the Butter Topping:
In a small bowl, mix the melted butter, garlic powder, and poppy seeds if using.
Brush the Tops:
Use a pastry brush to generously coat the tops of the assembled croissants with the butter mixture.
Bake the Croissants:
Arrange the croissants on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the croissants are golden brown.
Serve:
Remove from the oven and serve warm. Enjoy these deliciously flaky and cheesy croissants!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 5 minutes
 Bake Time: 15 minutes
 Total Time: 20 minutes
 Servings: 6 croissants

Ingredients:

1 cup light corn syrup
1 cup brown sugar, packed
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
3 large eggs

Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan.

Roll out the refrigerated pie crusts and press them into the bottom of the prepared baking pan. Ensure the crusts cover the entire base, pressing gently to seal any seams.
Make the Filling:
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the corn syrup, brown sugar, melted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt until smooth. Add the pecan halves and stir to coat them evenly.
Assemble the Bars:
Pour the pecan filling over the pie crust in the baking pan, spreading it out evenly.
Bake:
Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the filling is set and the top is golden brown.
Cool and Serve:
Allow the bars to cool completely in the pan before cutting them into 12 squares. Serve and enjoy!

Message:
Maple Caramel Bacon Crack 
Ingredients:
1 can 8 oz refrigerated crescent roll dough
1/2 cup pure maple syrup
1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
12 oz bacon, cooked until slightly chewy and torn into pieces
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Set your oven to 325F 165C.
Prepare the Baking Pan:
Line a 10x15-inch jelly roll pan with parchment paper.
Unroll the crescent roll dough onto the prepared pan, pressing the seams together to form a solid sheet.
Stretch the dough to fit the pan evenly and prick it all over with a fork.
Assemble the Topping:
Drizzle half of the maple syrup over the crescent roll dough.
Sprinkle about 1/4 cup of the brown sugar evenly over the syrup.
Distribute the torn bacon pieces over the brown sugar layer.
Drizzle the remaining maple syrup over the bacon.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of brown sugar on top.
Bake:
Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for approximately 20-25 minutes, or until the mixture is bubbling and caramelized.
Cool and Serve:
Remove the pan from the oven and allow it to cool to room temperature or until warm to the touch.
Once cooled, cut or break into pieces.
Serve at room temperature or slightly warmed.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes
 Cooking Time: 25 minutes
 Total Time: 40 minutes
 Servings: Approximately 12 pieces

Message:
Maple Caramel Bacon Crack Bites 
Ingredients:
2 packages 15 count each frozen phyllo cups 30 total
1 pound regular-cut bacon any flavor preference
1 cup packed light brown sugar
1/2 cup pure maple syrup
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Set your oven to 350F 175C.
Cook the Bacon:
In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the bacon until its nearly done but still slightly chewy.
Transfer the bacon to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess grease.
Once cooled, chop the bacon into small pieces.
Assemble the Phyllo Cups:
Arrange the phyllo cups on a large baking sheet.
Place 1/2 teaspoon of brown sugar into each phyllo cup.
Add a small drizzle of maple syrup over the brown sugar in each cup.
Fill each cup generously with the chopped bacon, mounding it slightly.
Sprinkle a pinch of the remaining brown sugar over the top of each filled cup.
Bake:
Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven.
Bake for approximately 12-15 minutes, or until the phyllo cups are crisp and the maple caramel is bubbly and caramelized.
Cool and Serve:
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and allow the bites to cool for about 5 minutes before serving.
Enjoy these sweet, salty, and smoky treats warm.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes
 Cooking Time: 15 minutes
 Total Time: 30 minutes
 Servings: 30 bites

Message:
蓼 Salted Caramel Cracker Bites 蓼
Ingredients:
4 cups about 200g oyster crackers
1/2 cup 113g unsalted butter
1/2 cup 100g packed brown sugar
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 teaspoon sea salt
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Set your oven to 350F 175C.
Prepare the Caramel Sauce:
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt the unsalted butter.
Add the packed brown sugar and ground cinnamon to the melted butter.
Stir continuously until the mixture reaches a gentle boil.
Allow it to boil for 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Remove the saucepan from heat and stir in the vanilla extract.
Coat the Crackers:
Place the oyster crackers in a large mixing bowl.
Pour the hot caramel sauce over the crackers.
Gently toss the crackers to ensure they are evenly coated with the caramel mixture.
Bake:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread the coated crackers in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
After 5 minutes, stir the crackers to ensure even baking.
Cool and Serve:
Remove the baking sheet from the oven.
While the crackers are still warm, sprinkle the sea salt evenly over them.
Allow the crackers to cool completely on the baking sheet.
Once cooled, transfer the salted caramel cracker bites to an airtight container for storage.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes
 Cooking Time: 10 minutes
 Total Time: 20 minutes
 Servings: Approximately 8
#SaltedCaramel #SnackRecipes #EasyTreats #SweetAndSalty #HomemadeSnacks

Message:
樂 Peanut Butter Balls with Rice Krispies 樂
Ingredients:
1 cup 240g creamy no-stir peanut butter
1/4 cup 56g salted butter, melted
2 cups 50g Rice Krispies cereal
2 cups 240g powdered sugar
2 cups 340g semi-sweet chocolate chips
Directions:
Combine Peanut Butter and Butter:
In a large mixing bowl, use a hand mixer or stand mixer to blend the creamy peanut butter and melted salted butter until smooth.

Dip the Balls:
Remove the chilled peanut butter balls from the refrigerator.
Using a fork or dipping tool, dip each ball into the melted chocolate, allowing any excess to drip off.
Place the coated balls back onto the parchment-lined baking sheet.
Set the Chocolate:
Refrigerate the dipped peanut butter balls until the chocolate coating is firm.

 Prep Time: 20 minutes

Message:
旅燎 Turkey Cheese Ball for Thanksgiving 燎旅
Ingredients:
For the Cheese Ball:
8 oz 225g cream cheese, softened
8 oz 225g whipped cream cheese plain or with chives
2 cups 200g shredded Italian blend cheese
1 packet 6 oz or 170g dry Italian dressing mix
For Decoration:
Pretzel rods and sticks
1/2 cup 60g chopped pecans
Candy eyes
Orange bell pepper
Directions:
Prepare the Cheese Mixture:
In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth.
Add the whipped cream cheese and dry Italian dressing mix; mix until well combined.
Stir in the shredded Italian blend cheese until evenly distributed.
Chill the Mixture:
Shape the cheese mixture into a rough ball using a spatula.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow the mixture to firm up.
Coat with Pecans:
Lay a piece of plastic wrap flat and spread the chopped pecans evenly over it.
Remove the chilled cheese ball from the refrigerator and gently shape it into a more defined ball with your hands.
Roll the cheese ball in the chopped pecans to coat it thoroughly, leaving the flat side from the bowl uncoated to serve as the base.
Assemble the Turkey Shape:
Place the pecan-coated cheese ball on a serving platter.
For the tail feathers, insert pretzel rods or sticks into the back of the cheese ball in a fan shape. Trim the pretzels as needed to achieve the desired length and effect.
For the neck and head, insert a pretzel rod into the front top of the cheese ball.
Attach candy eyes to the top of the pretzel rod using small dabs of cream cheese.
Cut a small triangle from the orange bell pepper to create a beak and attach it below the eyes with cream cheese.
Serve:
Surround the turkey cheese ball with an assortment of crackers and vegetables for dipping.
Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes
 Chill Time: 1 hour
 Total Time: 1 hour 20 minutes
 Servings: 12

Message:
Easy Caramel Fudge 
Ingredients:
1/3 cup 75g unsalted butter
1 cup 200g packed brown sugar
1 can 14 oz or 395g sweetened condensed milk
2 tablespoons 30ml golden syrup or corn syrup
7 oz 200g white chocolate, finely chopped
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 teaspoon salt
Directions:
Prepare the Pan:
Line an 8x8 inch 20x20 cm pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang around the edges for easy removal.
Melt the Base Ingredients:
In a heavy-bottomed saucepan over low heat, combine the unsalted butter, brown sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and golden syrup or corn syrup.
Stir continuously until the mixture is fully melted and smooth.
Cook the Mixture:
Once melted, continue to cook over low heat, bringing the mixture to a gentle boil.
Maintain this gentle boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Incorporate the Chocolate:
Remove the saucepan from the heat.
Immediately add the finely chopped white chocolate, vanilla extract, and salt.
Stir until the chocolate is completely melted and the mixture is smooth.
Set the Fudge:
Pour the mixture into the prepared pan, spreading it evenly.
Refrigerate for about 4 hours, or until the fudge is firm.
Slice and Serve:
Once set, lift the fudge out of the pan using the parchment overhang.
Place on a cutting board and slice into squares with a sharp knife.
Store in an airtight container.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes
 Chilling Time: 4 hours
 Total Time: 4 hours 15 minutes
 Servings: Approximately 32 pieces
#CaramelFudge #EasyDesserts #SweetTreats #HomemadeCandy #FudgeRecipes

Message:
蓼 Homemade Salted Caramels 蓼
Ingredients:
1/2 cup 113g salted butter, cut into 8 pieces
1/2 cup 120ml heavy cream 36% to 40% butterfat content
3 tablespoons 44ml water
1/4 cup 60ml light corn syrup
1 cup 200g granulated sugar
1/2 teaspoon flaked sea salt e.g., Maldon
Directions:
Prepare the Pan:
Lightly oil a 95-inch loaf pan.
Line it with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on the sides for easy removal.
Lightly oil the parchment paper and set the pan aside.
Heat Butter and Cream:
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the butter pieces and heavy cream.
Heat in the microwave for 1 to 2 minutes until the butter melts and the mixture is hot.
Set aside.
Combine Water, Corn Syrup, and Sugar:
In a small, heavy-bottomed saucepan, pour in the water and corn syrup.
Add the granulated sugar carefully to avoid splashing onto the sides.
Gently stir just enough to moisten the sugar.
Boil the Sugar Mixture:
Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover with a lid for 1 minute to create steam, which helps dissolve any sugar crystals on the sides.
Cook to Amber Color:
Remove the lid and attach a candy thermometer to the side of the saucepan.
Continue cooking without stirring until the mixture reaches 320F 160C and turns a light amber color around the edges, approximately 5 to 10 minutes.
Incorporate Butter and Cream:
Carefully and slowly pour about one-sixth of the butter and cream mixture into the sugar syrup, stirring with the base of the thermometer to incorporate.
Repeat this process, adding the mixture in small batches and stirring between each addition. Be cautious, as the mixture will bubble vigorously.
Cook to Final Temperature:
After all the butter and cream have been added, continue cooking the caramel until it reaches 240F 115C, about 5 to 10 minutes.
Pour into Prepared Pan:
Once the caramel reaches the desired temperature, carefully pour it into the prepared loaf pan.
Cool and Add Salt:
Allow the caramel to cool for about 20 minutes.
Sprinkle the flaked sea salt evenly over the top.
Let it cool completely, approximately 3  hours.
Cut and Wrap:
Once cooled, remove the caramel from the pan using the parchment overhang.
If the caramel is too soft to handle, refrigerate for 30 to 45 minutes to firm up.
Use a large, sharp knife to cut the caramel into desired shapes, such as 1-inch by 1/2-inch rectangles.
Wrap each piece individually in plastic wrap or waxed paper.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 3 hours 45 minutes
 Cooking Time: 20 minutes
 Total Time: 4 hours 5 minutes
 Servings: Approximately 40 caramels
#SaltedCaramels #HomemadeCandy #SweetTreats #CaramelLovers #DessertRecipes

Message:
Caramel Apple Cake 
Ingredients:
For the Cinnamon Apples:
5 pounds Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored, and diced into 1-inch pieces
1 cup granulated sugar
1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
1-2 tablespoons all-purpose flour if needed, to thicken
For the Pudding Layer:
2 packages 3.4 ounces each instant vanilla pudding mix
3 1/2 cups whole milk
1/2 cup sour cream
8 ounces whipped topping e.g., Cool Whip, thawed
For Assembly:
21 whole graham crackers cinnamon or regular
16 ounces caramel apple dip such as Marzetti brand
Directions:
Prepare the Cinnamon Apples:
In a large saucepan over medium-low heat, combine the diced apples, granulated sugar, and ground cinnamon.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the apples are tender. If the mixture is too juicy, sprinkle 1-2 tablespoons of flour over the apples and stir until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and allow the apples to cool to room temperature.
Prepare the Pudding Layer:
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the instant vanilla pudding mix and whole milk until smooth.
Stir in the sour cream until fully incorporated.
Gently fold in the thawed whipped topping until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Assemble the Éclair Cake:
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, place a single layer of graham crackers to cover the bottom.
Spread half of the cooled cinnamon apple mixture evenly over the graham crackers.
Spoon half of the pudding mixture over the apples, spreading it evenly.
Add another layer of graham crackers on top of the pudding layer.
Repeat with the remaining apple mixture and pudding mixture.
Finish with a final layer of graham crackers on top.
Add the Caramel Topping:
Warm the caramel apple dip in the microwave for 30 seconds to soften it, making it easier to spread.
Stir the caramel and, if necessary, heat for an additional 20-30 seconds until it reaches a spreadable consistency.
Evenly spread the softened caramel over the top layer of graham crackers.
Chill and Serve:
Cover the dish and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight to allow the layers to set and the flavors to meld.
Slice and serve chilled.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes
 Cook Time: 15 minutes
 Chill Time: 8 hours
 Servings: 15 slices
#CaramelAppleDessert #NoBakeCake #ÉclairCake #FallDesserts #AppleRecipes

Message:
Easy Caramel Apple Cinnamon Rolls 
Ingredients:
For the Filling:
2 tablespoons 28g unsalted butter
2 cups 200g diced Granny Smith apples about 2 medium apples
2 tablespoons 25g granulated sugar
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
For the Rolls:
1 can 8 rolls crescent roll dough
For the Frosting:
2 tablespoons 28g unsalted butter
1/4 cup 50g packed brown sugar
2-3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
1/2 cup 57g powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
Prepare the Filling:
In a small skillet over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons of butter.
Add the diced apples, granulated sugar, and cinnamon.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the apples begin to turn translucent, about 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and allow the mixture to cool for at least 10 minutes.
Assemble the Rolls:
Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.
Unroll the crescent roll dough onto a cutting board, keeping it in a rectangular shape. Press the seams together to form one solid rectangle.
Evenly spread the cooled apple mixture over the dough.
Starting from one short end, tightly roll up the dough into a log.
Using a serrated knife, slice the log into 8 equal pieces.
Place the rolls on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them evenly.
Bake:
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-25 minutes, or until the rolls are golden brown on top and cooked through.
Prepare the Frosting:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons of butter with the brown sugar.
Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and whisk in 2 tablespoons of heavy whipping cream until smooth. If a thinner consistency is desired, add an additional tablespoon of cream.
Whisk in the powdered sugar and vanilla extract until the frosting is smooth.
Frost the Rolls:
Allow the baked rolls to cool slightly before drizzling the caramel frosting over the top.
Serve warm and enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 45 minutes
 Cooking Time: 15-25 minutes
 Total Time: 1 hour 10 minutes
 Servings: 8 rolls
#CaramelAppleCinnamonRolls #EasyBaking #FallRecipes #BreakfastTreats #DessertDelights

Message:
Ingredients:
1 cup 200g granulated sugar
6 tablespoons 85g unsalted butter, cut into pieces
1/2 cup 120ml heavy cream
1 teaspoon vanilla extract optional
A pinch of salt optional, for salted caramel
Instructions:
1. Melt the Sugar: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, heat the sugar, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon or heatproof spatula. The sugar will clump and then melt into a thick amber-colored liquid. Be patient; this can take 5-7 minutes.
2. Add the Butter: Once the sugar is fully melted, add the butter pieces. Stir until the butter is fully incorporated. Be careful, as the mixture will bubble up vigorously.
3. Stir in the Cream: Slowly pour in the heavy cream while stirring. Again, the mixture will bubble up. Stir until fully combined.
4. Flavor and Finish: Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract and a pinch of salt if desired. Let the sauce cool for a few minutes.
5. Store: Transfer the caramel sauce to a glass jar or container and let it cool completely before sealing. It will thicken as it cools.
Tips:
If the sugar crystallizes while melting, reduce the heat slightly and keep stirring.
The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Reheat gently before using.

5. Store: Transfer the caramel sauce to a glass jar or container and let it cool completely before sealing. It will thicken as it cools.
Tips:
If the sugar crystallizes while melting, reduce the heat slightly and keep stirring.
The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Reheat gently before using.

Message:
便 Fluffy Coconut Custard Cake 便
Ingredients:
For the Coconut Cake:
1 cup 200g granulated sugar
1/2 cup 118ml vegetable oil
1/2 cup 113g unsalted butter, melted
1 large egg
1 large egg white
1 tablespoon 15ml coconut extract
1/2 cup 120g sour cream
2 1/2 cups 325g all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons 8g baking powder
1/2 teaspoon 2.5g baking soda
1/2 teaspoon 2.5g salt
1 cup 240ml coconut milk, well mixed
For the Coconut Custard Filling:
1/2 cup 118ml heavy whipping cream
2 tablespoons 16g cornstarch
1/2 cup 113g unsalted butter, melted
1/2 cup 100g granulated sugar
1 cup 80g sweetened shredded coconut
1 teaspoon 5ml vanilla extract
For the Cream Cheese Frosting:
8 ounces 226g cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup 113g unsalted butter, softened
4 cups 480g powdered sugar
1 teaspoon 5ml vanilla extract
For Garnish:
1 cup 80g sweetened shredded coconut, toasted
Directions:
Prepare the Cake Layers:
Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour three 8-inch round cake pans.
In a large mixing bowl, combine granulated sugar, vegetable oil, melted butter, egg, egg white, coconut extract, and sour cream. Beat on medium speed until well incorporated.
In a separate bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, alternating with the coconut milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
Divide the batter evenly among the prepared cake pans.
Bake for 20-24 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Prepare the Coconut Custard Filling:
In a small bowl, whisk together heavy whipping cream and cornstarch until smooth.
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine melted butter, granulated sugar, and shredded coconut. Stir until the mixture is nearly boiling.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the saucepan, stirring continuously until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract.
Allow the custard to cool completely before using.
Prepare the Cream Cheese Frosting:
In a large mixing bowl, beat softened cream cheese and butter until smooth and creamy.
Gradually add powdered sugar, one cup at a time, mixing on low speed until incorporated.
Add vanilla extract and increase speed to medium-high, beating until the frosting is light and fluffy.
Assemble the Cake:
Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Pipe a dam of cream cheese frosting around the edge to prevent the filling from spilling out.
Spread half of the coconut custard filling within the dam.
Place the second cake layer on top and repeat the process with the remaining custard filling.
Top with the third cake layer.
Apply a thin crumb coat of cream cheese frosting over the entire cake and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Apply a final layer of frosting, smoothing the sides and top.
Gently press toasted shredded coconut onto the sides and top of the cake for garnish.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 45 minutes  Cooking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 10 minutes
 Servings: 12 slices

Message:
Pumpkin Cheesecake Truffles 
Ingredients
4 tablespoons cream cheese, at room temperature
2 tablespoons confectioners sugar
1/3 cup pumpkin puree
2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
2 cups white chocolate chips
Directions:
Prepare the Filling: In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese and confectioners sugar with an electric mixer until creamy. Add the pumpkin puree and continue to beat until well combined. Mix in the graham cracker crumbs, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and cloves until fully incorporated. Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Form the Truffles: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Scoop the chilled mixture and roll into 1-inch balls, placing them on the prepared baking sheets. Once all the dough is shaped, chill the balls for an additional 30 minutes.
Melt the Chocolate: In the last few minutes of chilling, set up a double boiler by placing a heat-safe bowl over a saucepan with 2 inches of water. Ensure the bowl doesnt touch the water. Add the white chocolate chips to the bowl and heat over medium, stirring until melted. Let the melted chocolate rest for 2 minutes.
Coat the Truffles: Remove the truffle balls from the refrigerator. Dip each ball into the melted chocolate, using a fork to lift and allow excess chocolate to drip off before placing it back on the parchment-lined baking sheet. If desired, sprinkle with additional graham cracker crumbs before the chocolate sets.
Set and Serve: Return the truffles to the refrigerator and allow the chocolate to set completely before serving.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes plus chilling time
 Servings: Approximately 24 truffles
#PumpkinTruffles #CheesecakeBites #FallDesserts #NoBakeTreats #SweetIndulgence

Message:
便 Mounds Poke Cake 便
Ingredients:
1 box of chocolate cake mix plus ingredients required on the box, typically water, oil, and eggs
1 14 oz can of sweetened condensed milk
1 15 oz can of coconut cream
1 7 oz package of shredded sweetened coconut
1 12 oz container of chocolate frosting
Optional: additional shredded coconut or almond slivers for garnish
Directions:
Preheat the Oven: Set your oven to 350F 175C or as directed on the cake mix package.
Prepare the Cake Batter: Follow the instructions on the chocolate cake mix box to prepare the batter. Pour it into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake the Cake: Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake according to the package instructions, typically 25-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Poke Holes: While the cake is still warm, use the handle of a wooden spoon to poke holes evenly across the surface of the cake.
Prepare the Filling: In a medium bowl, combine the sweetened condensed milk and coconut cream. Mix well.
Pour the Filling: Pour the coconut mixture over the cake, ensuring it seeps into the holes. Allow the cake to cool completely, letting it absorb the filling.
Add Coconut Layer: Once cooled, evenly sprinkle the shredded sweetened coconut over the top of the cake.
Frost the Cake: Microwave the chocolate frosting for 20-30 seconds until it reaches a pourable consistency. Pour it over the coconut layer, spreading it evenly.
Garnish and Chill: If desired, sprinkle additional shredded coconut or almond slivers on top. Refrigerate the cake for at least 1 hour to set before serving.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 45 minutes including chilling time
 Servings: 12

Message:
HOT FUDGE PIE  Simple & Delicious! 
Ingredients:
1 stick of butter, softened
1 cup of sugar
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
3 tablespoons cocoa powder
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup all-purpose flour
Instructions:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
In a mixing bowl, cream the softened butter and sugar with an electric mixer until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add the eggs and vanilla, then mix by hand until everything is fully incorporated.
Gently stir in the cocoa powder, salt, and flour by hand until the batter is smooth and gooey. Tip: Hand-mixing keeps the texture extra rich and gooey!
Grease an 8-inch pie pan with butter or cooking spray, then pour the batter into the pan.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until the center is set.
Indulge in this decadent, gooey Hot Fudge Pie!
