Monterey Chicken Spaghetti
Cheesy Chicken Spaghetti Casserole with a Crunchy Topping
Ingredients:
12 ounces dried spaghetti
4 cups chopped cooked chicken
1 16-ounce container sour cream
2 10.5-ounce cans unsalted cream of chicken soup
1 10-ounce package frozen spinach, thawed and drained
2 cups shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 6-ounce can Frenchs French Fried Onions, divided
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F. Lightly spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Prepare the Pasta:
Cook the spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Mix Ingredients:
In a large bowl, combine the chopped chicken, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, drained spinach, 1 cup of Monterey Jack cheese, minced garlic, and half of the French Fried Onions.
Combine Pasta and Mixture:
Stir the cooked spaghetti into the chicken mixture. Pour the combined mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Add Toppings:
Sprinkle the remaining Monterey Jack cheese over the pasta, then top with the rest of the French Fried Onions.
Bake:
Place the casserole in the oven and bake uncovered for 40 to 50 minutes, until hot and bubbly, and the onions are golden brown.
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cook Time: 50 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 5 minutes
Servings: 8 servings

Message:
Mac and Cheese Meatloaf Casserole
Ingredients:
For the Meatloaf Layer:
1 pound ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1/4 cup ketchup
1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon onion powder
Salt and pepper to taste
For the Mac and Cheese Layer:
2 cups elbow macaroni, cooked
2 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
2 cups milk
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
1/4 teaspoon mustard powder optional
Salt and pepper to taste
For Topping:
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/4 cup breadcrumbs optional
Directions:
Prepare the Meatloaf:
Preheat your oven to 375F 190C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until well combined. Press the meatloaf mixture evenly into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Bake for 20-25 minutes until partially cooked.
Make the Mac and Cheese:
While the meatloaf is baking, melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. Gradually whisk in the milk and bring to a simmer. Cook until thickened, about 3-4 minutes. Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese, mustard powder if using, salt, and pepper. Mix until the cheese is fully melted and the sauce is smooth. Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and stir until well coated.
Assemble the Casserole:
Remove the meatloaf layer from the oven and carefully spread the mac and cheese mixture over the top. Sprinkle the extra shredded cheese and breadcrumbs over the mac and cheese layer for a crispy topping.
Bake:
Return the casserole to the oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden and the meatloaf is fully cooked.
Serve:
Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy this hearty comfort dish!
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 40 minutes  Total Time: 55 minutes
Calories: 550 kcal  Servings: 6 servings

樂 Praline Crunch 樂
Ingredients:
1 box 12.8 ounces Crispix cereal
2 cups pecan halves
1 cup 2 sticks butter
1 cup packed brown sugar
2 tablespoons light corn syrup
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
Directions:
Prepare the Oven: Preheat your oven to 250F 120C. Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Mix Cereal and Pecans: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Crispix cereal and pecan halves. Set aside.
Make the Praline Sauce: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Stir in the brown sugar and corn syrup. Bring the mixture to a boil, stirring constantly. Once it boils, let it cook for 2 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat and quickly stir in the baking soda. The mixture will bubble up and become light and frothy.
Coat the Cereal and Pecans: Immediately pour the praline sauce over the cereal and pecan mixture. Gently stir to coat everything evenly.
Bake the Crunch: Divide the coated cereal mixture between the prepared baking sheets. Spread it out evenly. Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes to ensure even coating and crunchiness.
Cool and Enjoy: Once baked, remove from the oven and let the praline crunch cool completely on the baking sheets. Break it into pieces and enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 1 hour  Total Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
 Kcal: 250 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings

Message:
Honey Garlic Shrimp, Sausage & Broccoli
Ingredients:
1 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined
8 oz smoked sausage, sliced
2 cups broccoli florets
3 tablespoons honey
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 tablespoon butter
Salt and pepper to taste
Directions:
Cook the Sausage:
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced sausage and cook for 4-5 minutes until browned. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Sauté the Broccoli:
In the same skillet, add the butter and broccoli. Sauté for 3-4 minutes until the broccoli is crisp-tender. Remove from the skillet and set aside with the sausage.
Cook the Shrimp:
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until they turn pink and are cooked through.
Make the Honey Garlic Sauce:
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic. Pour the mixture over the shrimp and let it simmer for 2 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken.
Combine and Serve:
Return the sausage and broccoli to the skillet, tossing everything in the honey garlic sauce. Serve hot.
Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 15 minutes  Total Time: 25 minutes
Calories: 400 kcal  Servings: 4 servings

Message:
Cinnamon Roll Cheesecake
A delightful fusion of creamy cheesecake and gooey cinnamon rolls, this Cinnamon Roll Cheesecake is a dessert dream come true. Perfect for any occasion, this indulgent treat will leave everyone asking for seconds!
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup sugar
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
6 tablespoons melted butter
For the Cinnamon Swirl:
1/2 cup packed brown sugar
1 1/2 tablespoons ground cinnamon
5 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
For the Cheesecake Filling:
24 ounces cream cheese, softened
1 cup sugar
1/4 cup sour cream
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
3 large eggs
For the Cream Cheese Frosting:
4 ounces cream cheese, softened
2 tablespoons butter, softened
1 cup powdered sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
2-3 tablespoons heavy cream for desired consistency
Instructions:
Preheat Oven: Preheat your oven to 325F 160C. Line a 9-inch springform pan with parchment paper and lightly grease the sides.
Make the Crust: In a bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, cinnamon, and melted butter. Press the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan and set aside.
Prepare Cinnamon Swirl: In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar, cinnamon, and melted butter to create a cinnamon swirl mixture. Set aside.
Make Cheesecake Filling: In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar, sour cream, and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined. Incorporate the eggs one at a time, mixing after each addition until just combined.
Assemble: Pour half of the cheesecake filling into the crust. Drizzle half of the cinnamon swirl mixture over the top. Use a knife or toothpick to swirl it into the batter. Repeat with the remaining cheesecake filling and cinnamon swirl.
Bake: Bake the cheesecake for 50-60 minutes, or until the center is set but still slightly jiggly. Turn off the oven and crack the door, allowing the cheesecake to cool gradually for 1 hour.
Make Cream Cheese Frosting: Beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and heavy cream until smooth and fluffy. Spread the frosting over the cooled cheesecake.
Chill: Refrigerate the cheesecake for at least 4 hours or overnight before serving.
Enjoy: Slice, serve, and savor the bliss of this cinnamon roll-inspired cheesecake!

Message:
One-Pot Chicken Parmesan Pasta
Ingredients:
2-3 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1 medium yellow onion, minced
3 cloves garlic, minced
16 ounces dried short-cut pasta e.g., rigatoni
24-ounce jar of marinara sauce e.g., Newmans Own
Water to fill the empty marinara sauce jar
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
Salt and pepper, to taste
Additional dried Italian seasoning, optional
Fresh parsley and/or basil, minced for garnish
Instructions:
Cook the Chicken:
In a large pot or skillet such as a Dutch oven, drizzle olive oil and heat over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and season with salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until the chicken is mostly cooked through. Remove the chicken to a plate and set aside.
Sauté the Onion and Garlic:
In the same pot, add the minced onion and garlic. Cook for about 2-3 minutes, until the onion is soft and translucent.
Prepare the Sauce:
Pour in the marinara sauce, then fill the empty sauce jar with water and add it to the pot. Stir well and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce to a strong simmer.
Cook the Pasta and Chicken:
Return the chicken to the pot along with the dried pasta. Stir to combine, then cover and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked to your liking.
Add the Cheese:
Stir in the Parmesan cheese and 1/4 cup of the shredded mozzarella cheese. Mix well until the cheese is melted and incorporated.
Finish with Mozzarella:
Sprinkle the remaining 3/4 cup of mozzarella cheese on top of the dish. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and gooey.
Garnish and Serve:
If desired, sprinkle with additional Italian seasoning. Garnish with fresh parsley or basil, and serve hot. Enjoy your cheesy one-pot chicken parmesan pasta!
Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 35 minutes
Calories: 620 kcal per serving  Servings: 4-6 servings

Message:
Smores Brownies
Ingredients:
1 package of graham crackers about 12-15 full crackers
1/2 cup sugar
6 tablespoons melted butter
1 box brownie mix prepared according to package directions
1 10 oz package miniature marshmallows
1 cup chocolate chips
Instructions:
Prepare the Crust:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Place the graham crackers in a food processor and pulse until finely crushed. Add the melted butter and sugar to the crumbs, pulsing again until the mixture is well combined and slightly wet. Press the graham cracker mixture evenly into the bottom of a parchment-lined 9x13-inch baking dish.
Prepare the Brownie Layer:
Prepare the brownie mix according to the package directions. Pour the prepared brownie batter over the graham cracker crust, spreading it out evenly.
Bake:
Bake the brownies in the preheated oven for 22-25 minutes, or until the center is set.
Add Marshmallows and Chocolate Chips:
Remove the brownies from the oven and immediately top with miniature marshmallows and chocolate chips.
Broil:
Turn your oven to broil. Place the brownie dish under the broiler for about 3 minutes, or until the marshmallows start to brown. Keep a close eye on them to avoid burning.
Cool and Serve:
Allow the brownies to cool slightly before slicing and serving.

Message:
Homemade Fried Cheese Bites 
Ingredients:
1 block 16 ounces mozzarella cheese or any cheese of your choice
1 cup all-purpose flour
2 large eggs
2 tablespoons water
1 cup Italian-style breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
Vegetable oil for frying
Marinara sauce for dipping
1 tablespoon vodka optional, for a crispier coating
Directions:
Prepare the Cheese: Cut the block of cheese into bite-sized cubes about 1 inch. Place the cheese cubes in the freezer for 20-30 minutes to firm up.
Set up Breading Station: In one shallow dish, add the flour. In a second dish, whisk together the eggs and water. In a third dish, combine the breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan, garlic powder, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Coat the Cheese Bites: Remove the cheese cubes from the freezer. Dip each cheese cube into the flour, shaking off excess, then into the egg mixture, and finally coat it with the breadcrumb mixture. For extra crispiness, repeat the egg and breadcrumb coating step for a double layer.
Heat the Oil: Pour vegetable oil into a deep skillet or saucepan, about 2 inches deep, and heat over medium-high heat until it reaches 350F 175C.
Fry the Cheese Bites: Carefully place a few cheese bites into the hot oil at a time. Fry for 1-2 minutes or until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil. Repeat with the remaining cheese bites.
Serve: Serve the fried cheese bites hot with marinara sauce for dipping. If desired, you can stir 1 tablespoon of vodka into the marinara sauce to enhance the flavor and texture.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 25 minutes
 Kcal: 310 kcal per serving   Servings: 6 servings

Message:
旅療 Mini Turkey Cupcakes 療旅
Ingredients:
1 box vanilla cake mix plus ingredients listed on the box: eggs, oil, and water
1 can 16 ounces chocolate frosting
Candy corn for feathers
Mini chocolate chips for eyes
Candy eyes optional, for a more defined look
Orange and red fondant or candy for beak and wattle
Mini pretzels for wings
Directions:
Prepare the Cupcakes: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and line a mini muffin tin with cupcake liners. Prepare the vanilla cake mix according to the package instructions. Spoon the batter into the lined muffin tin, filling each about 2/3 full. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cupcakes to cool completely.
Frost the Cupcakes: Once the cupcakes have cooled, spread a layer of chocolate frosting on top of each one, creating a smooth base for decorating.
Create the Turkey Feathers: Press candy corn into the frosting on the back half of each cupcake to resemble turkey feathers. Use about 4-5 pieces of candy corn per cupcake.
Make the Turkey Face: For the eyes, you can either use mini chocolate chips or candy eyes, pressing them into the frosting on the front of the cupcake. Roll a tiny piece of orange fondant or candy into a cone shape to form the beak, and add a small piece of red fondant for the wattle. Attach them to the cupcake right below the eyes.
Add the Wings: Break mini pretzels in half and press each half into the sides of the cupcake to resemble turkey wings.
Serve and Enjoy: Display your adorable mini turkey cupcakes and enjoy this festive, fun treat for Thanksgiving or any fall gathering!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 12 minutes  Total Time: 27 minutes
 Kcal: 180 kcal per serving   Servings: 24 mini cupcakes

Message:
French Onion Beef and Noodles
Ingredients:
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 pound beef stew meat
1 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon garlic powder
Salt and pepper, to taste
1 can 10.5 ounces French onion soup
3 cups beef broth
12 ounces egg noodles
 cup sour cream
 cup Parmesan cheese
1 cup French fried onions
Instructions:
Heat the Oil: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the Beef: Add the beef stew meat, seasoning it with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Sauté for 3-5 minutes until the beef is browned on all sides.
Simmer with Soup and Broth: Pour in the French onion soup and beef broth. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat and let it cook on low for 10 minutes.
Cook the Noodles: Add the egg noodles to the pot and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the noodles are tender.
Add Dairy: Remove the pot from heat and stir in the sour cream and Parmesan cheese until well combined.
Serve: Top with French fried onions before serving.

Message:
Sweet and Crunchy Praline Party Mix
Ingredients:
3 cups Corn Chex cereal
3 cups Rice Chex cereal
3 cups Crispix cereal
2 cups pretzels
2 cups pecan halves
1 cup unsalted butter
1 cup light brown sugar
 teaspoon salt
Instructions:
Mix the Dry Ingredients:
In a large bowl, combine the Corn Chex, Rice Chex, Crispix, pretzels, and pecans. Toss gently to ensure even distribution.
Prepare the Praline Coating:
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the brown sugar and salt, stirring frequently. Bring the mixture to a boil and let it bubble for 1-2 minutes.
Coat the Mix:
Pour the hot praline mixture over the cereal and pretzel blend. Toss gently to ensure that everything is evenly coated.
Bake and Stir:
Spread the coated mixture evenly onto a rimmed baking sheet. Bake at 250F 120C for 10 minutes, then remove and stir.
Continue Baking:
Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes to ensure even cooking.
Cool and Store:
Once baked, allow the mix to cool completely. Store in an airtight container to maintain freshness.

Message:
Sweet Hawaiian Crockpot Chicken 
Ingredients:
2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs
1 can 20 oz pineapple chunks, drained reserve juice
1 red bell pepper, diced
1 yellow bell pepper, diced
1 cup barbecue sauce
1/2 cup soy sauce
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup cornstarch
1/4 cup cold water
Cooked rice for serving
Green onions and sesame seeds for garnish
Directions:
Place the chicken in the crockpot.
Add pineapple chunks, red and yellow bell peppers.
Whisk together reserved pineapple juice, BBQ sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger, and garlic. Pour over chicken.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours.
Shred chicken, return to crockpot.
Mix cornstarch and water, add to crockpot to thicken the sauce.
Cook an additional 15-20 minutes.
Serve over rice, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 mins  Cook Time: 6 hours  Total Time: 6 hrs 15 mins
 400 kcal per serving   Servings: 6

Message:
Strawberry Cheesecake Pound Cake 
Ingredients:
For the Pound Cake:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened
2 cups granulated sugar
4 large eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 cups all-purpose flour
1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup milk
1 cup fresh strawberries, diced
For the Cheesecake Filling:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 large egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
For the Strawberry Glaze optional:
1/2 cup powdered sugar
2 tbsp strawberry puree blend fresh strawberries
1 tsp lemon juice
Instructions:
Make the Pound Cake Batter:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and grease a bundt or loaf pan with butter and flour.
In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the dry mixture to the butter mixture, alternating with the milk. Start and finish with the flour mixture. Gently fold in the diced strawberries.
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In another bowl, mix the softened cream cheese, sugar, egg, and vanilla until smooth.
Assemble the Cake:
Pour half of the pound cake batter into the prepared pan. Evenly spread the cheesecake filling over the batter. Then, pour the remaining pound cake batter on top, smoothing the surface.
Bake:
Bake for 60-70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the pan for about 10-15 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
Optional Strawberry Glaze:
In a small bowl, whisk together powdered sugar, strawberry puree, and lemon juice until smooth. Drizzle over the cooled cake before serving.
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Cook Time: 70 minutes
Total Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Servings: 10
Calories: 450 kcal per serving

Message:
Twix Cookies 
Ingredients:
For the Shortbread Cookies:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/4 teaspoon salt
For the Caramel Layer:
15 soft caramels, unwrapped
2 tablespoons heavy cream
For the Chocolate Layer:
1 cup milk chocolate chips
1 teaspoon vegetable oil
Directions:
1. Prepare the Shortbread Cookies:
Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream the butter and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
Mix in the vanilla extract. Gradually add the flour and salt, blending until just combined.
Roll the dough into 1-inch balls, place them on the baking sheet, and slightly flatten each ball with your hand or the bottom of a glass.
Bake for 12-14 minutes, or until the edges begin to turn golden. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.
2. Make the Caramel Layer:
In a small saucepan, melt the caramels with the heavy cream over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Spoon about 1 teaspoon of caramel onto each cooled cookie, spreading it evenly. Let it set for 10 minutes.
3. Make the Chocolate Layer:
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and vegetable oil. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until the chocolate is melted and smooth.
Drizzle or spoon the melted chocolate over the caramel layer on each cookie.
4. Serve and Enjoy:
Let the chocolate set before serving. These cookies capture the essence of the classic Twix bar, with buttery shortbread, gooey caramel, and a rich chocolate topping!
Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cook Time: 14 minutes  Total Time: 45 minutes
Calories: 180 kcal per cookie  Servings: 24 cookies

In a small saucepan, melt the caramels with the heavy cream over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Spoon about 1 teaspoon of caramel onto each cooled cookie, spreading it evenly. Let it set for 10 minutes.
3. Make the Chocolate Layer:
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and vegetable oil. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until the chocolate is melted and smooth.
Drizzle or spoon the melted chocolate over the caramel layer on each cookie.
4. Serve and Enjoy:
Let the chocolate set before serving. These cookies capture the essence of the classic Twix bar, with buttery shortbread, gooey caramel, and a rich chocolate topping!

Calories: 180 kcal per cookie  Servings: 24 cookies

Message:
Warm Up with Creamy Potato Hamburger Soup 
A comforting blend of ground beef, tender potatoes, and a creamy broth, perfect for a cozy meal!
Ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
4 large potatoes, peeled and cubed
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
4 cups beef broth
1 cup heavy cream
2 carrots, peeled and diced
2 stalks celery, diced
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1/2 teaspoon paprika
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese for garnish
Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Instructions:
Cook the Beef:
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add ground beef, onion, and garlic, cooking until the beef is browned and onions are soft.
Add Vegetables:
Stir in the carrots and celery, cooking for another 5 minutes until they start to soften.
Thicken the Soup:
Sprinkle the flour over the mixture, stirring to coat the beef and veggies. Gradually add the beef broth, stirring to combine.
Add Potatoes & Season:
Mix in the cubed potatoes, salt, pepper, and paprika. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Finish with Cream:
Stir in the heavy cream and allow it to heat through. Serve the soup hot, garnished with shredded cheddar cheese and fresh parsley.
Enjoy!

Message:
Garlic Butter Shrimp with Creamy Mashed Potatoes 
Ingredients:
For the Shrimp:
1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
4 tbsp unsalted butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup white wine optional
1/4 cup chicken broth
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes optional
Salt and pepper, to taste
Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
For the Mashed Potatoes:
2 lbs potatoes, peeled and diced
1/2 cup milk
1/4 cup unsalted butter
Salt and pepper, to taste
Instructions:
Make the Mashed Potatoes:
Boil the diced potatoes in salted water for about 15 minutes, or until tender.
Drain the water, return the potatoes to the pot, and mash them with milk and butter until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook the Shrimp:
In a large skillet over medium heat, melt the butter.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until pink and fully cooked.
If using, pour in the white wine and chicken broth. Let it simmer for 2 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly.
Season with red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Garnish with fresh parsley.
Serve:
Plate the garlic butter shrimp over a bed of creamy mashed potatoes for a comforting, delicious meal.
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes  Servings: 4

Message:
Sweet and Crunchy Praline Party Mix
Ingredients:
3 cups Corn Chex cereal
3 cups Rice Chex cereal
3 cups Crispix cereal
2 cups pretzels
2 cups pecan halves
1 cup unsalted butter
1 cup light brown sugar
 teaspoon salt
Instructions:
Mix the Dry Ingredients:
In a large bowl, combine the Corn Chex, Rice Chex, Crispix, pretzels, and pecans. Toss gently to ensure even distribution.
Prepare the Praline Coating:
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the brown sugar and salt, stirring frequently. Bring the mixture to a boil and let it bubble for 1-2 minutes.
Coat the Mix:
Pour the hot praline mixture over the cereal and pretzel blend. Toss gently to ensure that everything is evenly coated.
Bake and Stir:
Spread the coated mixture evenly onto a rimmed baking sheet. Bake at 250F 120C for 10 minutes, then remove and stir.
Continue Baking:
Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes to ensure even cooking.
Cool and Store:
Once baked, allow the mix to cool completely. Store in an airtight container to maintain freshness.

Message:
Chicken Bacon Ranch Pinwheels 肋燎
Ingredients:
3 cooked or grilled chicken breasts
1 pound thick-cut bacon, cooked
8 ounces cream cheese, softened
1 cup shredded cheddar and jack cheese mix
1/2 packet Ranch seasoning
4 large burrito-sized tortillas
Instructions:
Prepare the Filling:
Finely chop the cooked chicken breasts and bacon into 1/4-inch dice.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped chicken, bacon, cream cheese, and shredded cheddar and jack cheese mix.
Sprinkle the Ranch seasoning evenly over the mixture and gently mix until well combined.
Assemble the Pinwheels:
Spread a thin layer of the chicken-bacon-cheese mixture evenly over each tortilla.
Roll each tortilla tightly into a log shape, then let them sit for a few minutes with the seam side down to help seal.
Slice and Serve:
Using a sharp knife, slice each rolled tortilla into 3/4 to 1-inch thick pinwheels.
Arrange the chicken bacon ranch pinwheels on a platter and serve.

Message:
Cream Cheese Lemonade Pie 不
Ingredients:
For the Creamy Pie:
1 5 oz can evaporated milk
1 3.4 oz box instant lemon pudding mix
2 8 oz packages cream cheese
 cup frozen lemonade concentrate
For the Pie Crust:
2  cups graham cracker crumbs
 cup sugar
 cup butter, melted
Alternatively, use 1 9-inch pre-made graham cracker crust for a no-bake option.
Directions:
For the Pie Crust:
In a bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Press the mixture into a deep dish pie plate, making sure to cover the sides evenly.
Bake at 350F for 10-12 minutes. Allow to cool. Skip this step if using a pre-made crust.
For the Creamy Pie:
In a small bowl, whisk together the evaporated milk and pudding mix. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes until thickened.
In a separate bowl, beat the cream cheese until fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Gradually add the lemonade concentrate and the pudding mixture to the cream cheese, beating until smooth.
Spoon the filling into the cooled crust. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours to set.
Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 10 minutes if baking the crust
Total Time: 4 hours 25 minutes includes chilling
Servings:

Message:
Cheesy Garlic Chicken Wraps
Ingredients 
2 chicken breasts, cubed
1 tbsp olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp onion powder
Salt and pepper, to taste
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1/4 cup sour cream
1/4 cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
4 large flour tortillas
Directions 
Cook the Chicken: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the cubed chicken, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Sauté for about 6-8 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown.
Make the Garlic Sauce: In a small bowl, mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise, minced garlic, and parsley. Stir well and set aside.
Assemble the Wraps: Lay out the tortillas. Evenly divide the cooked chicken among the tortillas. Sprinkle the cheddar and mozzarella cheeses over the chicken, then drizzle with the garlic sauce.
Wrap and Toast: Fold in the sides of the tortillas and roll them up tightly. Heat a clean skillet over medium heat and toast the wraps for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden and crispy, ensuring the cheese melts.
Serve: Cut the wraps in half and enjoy your cheesy, garlicky goodness!
Prep Time : 10 minutes
Cook Time : 15 minutes
Total Time : 25 minutes
Servings : 4
Calories : 500 kcal per serving

Message:
Famous Red Lobster Shrimp Scampi
Ingredients:
1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
4 tbsp unsalted butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup white wine or chicken broth
1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes optional
1/2 tsp salt or to taste
1/4 tsp black pepper or to taste
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
Lemon wedges, for serving
Instructions:
Cook the Shrimp:
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, being careful not to let it brown.
Add the Shrimp:
Add the shrimp to the skillet and season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes if you like a bit of heat.
Cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they turn pink and opaque.
Prepare the Sauce:
Pour in the white wine or chicken broth and fresh lemon juice.
Let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes, allowing the flavors to blend.
Finish the Dish:
Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese over the shrimp and stir until it melts into the sauce.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the fresh parsley.
Serve:
Transfer the shrimp scampi to a serving dish and garnish with lemon wedges.
Serve immediately and enjoy!
Quick Summary:
Sauté garlic in butter.
Cook shrimp with seasoning until pink.
Simmer with white wine or broth and lemon juice.
Stir in Parmesan and parsley.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.

Message:
Twix Cookies 
Ingredients:
For the Shortbread Cookies:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/4 teaspoon salt
For the Caramel Layer:
15 soft caramels, unwrapped
2 tablespoons heavy cream
For the Chocolate Layer:
1 cup milk chocolate chips
1 teaspoon vegetable oil
Directions:
1. Prepare the Shortbread Cookies:
Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream the butter and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
Mix in the vanilla extract. Gradually add the flour and salt, blending until just combined.
Roll the dough into 1-inch balls, place them on the baking sheet, and slightly flatten each ball with your hand or the bottom of a glass.
Bake for 12-14 minutes, or until the edges begin to turn golden. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.
2. Make the Caramel Layer:
In a small saucepan, melt the caramels with the heavy cream over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Spoon about 1 teaspoon of caramel onto each cooled cookie, spreading it evenly. Let it set for 10 minutes.
3. Make the Chocolate Layer:
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and vegetable oil. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until the chocolate is melted and smooth.
Drizzle or spoon the melted chocolate over the caramel layer on each cookie.
4. Serve and Enjoy:
Let the chocolate set before serving. These cookies capture the essence of the classic Twix bar, with buttery shortbread, gooey caramel, and a rich chocolate topping!
Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cook Time: 14 minutes  Total Time: 45 minutes
Calories: 180 kcal per cookie  Servings: 24 cookies

Message:
Gooey Chocolate Chip Pie 
Ingredients:
3/4 cup butter room temperature
3/4 cup brown sugar
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 egg
2 tsp vanilla extract
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp cornstarch
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup semisweet chocolate chips
3/4 cup mini chocolate chips
1 cup mini marshmallows reserve some for garnish
Directions:
1 Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and lightly flour a 9-inch pie plate.
2 Cream the Ingredients:
In a large bowl, cream together the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined.
3 Mix the Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt to the wet mixture, stirring until just combined.
4 Fold in the Goodies:
Gently fold in the semisweet chocolate chips, mini chocolate chips, and mini marshmallows.
5 Prepare for Baking:
Press the dough evenly into the greased pie plate.
6 Bake:
Bake for 20-25 minutes if you prefer a gooey center, or up to 30 minutes for a firmer texture. Let the pie cool before slicing.
Prep Time: 10 minutes
Cook Time: 25 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Calories: Approx. 350 kcal per slice
Servings: 8 slices
Enjoy this indulgent chocolate chip pie warm with a scoop of ice cream for the ultimate dessert experience!

Message:
不 Easy Chocolate Mousse Pie 不
Ingredients:
Crust:
24 Oreo cookies finely crushed
5 tablespoons butter, melted
Chocolate Mousse Filling:
1 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream
1/4 cup powdered sugar
2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream for melting chocolate
Topping:
1 cup heavy whipping cream
2 tablespoons powdered sugar
Chocolate shavings or curls optional, for garnish
Directions:
Prepare the Crust:
Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. In a medium bowl, mix the crushed Oreo cookies with the melted butter until well combined. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie dish. Bake the crust for 10 minutes, then remove it from the oven and allow it to cool completely.
Make the Chocolate Mousse Filling Step 1:
In a small saucepan, heat 1 1/4 cups of heavy whipping cream over medium heat until it just begins to simmer. Remove from heat, and immediately pour the hot cream over the semi-sweet chocolate chips in a heat-safe bowl. Let it sit for 2-3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Set aside to cool to room temperature.
Make the Chocolate Mousse Filling Step 2:
In a separate large mixing bowl, beat 1 1/4 cups of heavy whipping cream with 1/4 cup of powdered sugar until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the cooled chocolate mixture into the whipped cream until fully combined and smooth.
Assemble the Pie:
Pour the chocolate mousse filling into the cooled Oreo crust, smoothing the top with a spatula. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until the filling is set.
Prepare the Whipped Topping:
In a large mixing bowl, beat 1 cup of heavy whipping cream with 2 tablespoons of powdered sugar until soft peaks form. Spread the whipped cream over the set chocolate mousse layer.
Garnish and Serve:
Garnish with chocolate shavings or curls if desired. Slice and serve this decadent chocolate mousse pie chilled for the best texture.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 25 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 4 hours 35 minutes including chilling
 Kcal: 510 kcal per serving   Servings: 10 servings
#ChocolateMoussePie #DessertRecipes #EasyBaking #ChocolateLovers #NoBakePie

RumChata White Russian 拏
Ingredients:
2 oz RumChata
1 oz vodka
1 oz Kahlúa or other coffee liqueur
Ice cubes
Whipped cream optional
Cinnamon stick for garnish optional

Message:
Sweet Potato Cranberry Pecan Stuffing 
Ingredients:
1 loaf of French bread about 12 cups, cubed
2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
1 tablespoon olive oil
1/2 cup butter
1 large onion, chopped
3 celery stalks, chopped
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
1 teaspoon dried sage
1 teaspoon dried thyme
2 1/2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup dried cranberries
1/2 cup pecans, chopped
1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped optional
Directions:
Prepare the Bread: Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. Cut the French bread into 1-inch cubes and spread them in a single layer on a baking sheet. Toast in the oven for about 10 minutes, until lightly crisp. Remove and set aside.
Cook the Sweet Potatoes: Toss the diced sweet potatoes with olive oil, place on a baking sheet, and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender. Set aside.
Sauté Vegetables: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and celery, and cook for 6-8 minutes until softened. Season with salt, pepper, sage, and thyme, stirring to combine.
Combine Ingredients: In a large mixing bowl, combine the toasted bread cubes, sautéed vegetables, roasted sweet potatoes, dried cranberries, and chopped pecans. Toss gently to mix all the ingredients.
Add Broth: Pour the chicken broth over the mixture, tossing to combine. The stuffing should be moist but not soggy. Adjust the amount of broth as needed.
Bake the Stuffing: Transfer the stuffing to a greased baking dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350F 175C for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes until the top is golden and slightly crispy.
Serve: Garnish with fresh parsley optional and serve this flavorful stuffing as a delicious side dish for any meal!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 40 minutes  Total Time: 55 minutes
 Kcal: 280 kcal per serving   Servings: 8 servings

Fun Oreo Spider Cookies 
Ingredients:
24 Oreo cookies
1 can 16 oz vanilla frosting
5 oz chocolate Pocky sticks or pretzel sticks, halved
1 oz candy eyes or M&Ms
Directions:
Prepare the Spiders:
Twist apart the Oreo cookies, keeping the cream filling intact on one side. Spread a little vanilla frosting over the filling.
Create Spider Legs:
Cut the Pocky sticks into 1 to 1.5-inch pieces. Press four pieces into the frosting on each side to resemble spider legs.
Add the Top:
Gently press the other half of the Oreo back on top, securing the legs.
Add Eyes:
Dab a bit of frosting on two candy eyes or M&Ms and place them on the top of each Oreo between the legs.
Set and Serve:
Let the spiders set for 10-15 minutes. Refrigerate for quicker setting, if needed. Enjoy this spooky treat!

 Kcal: 129 kcal per cookie   Servings: 24 cookies

Message:
One-Pot Macaroni Cheeseburger Soup  NO VELVEETA! 燎
Ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 medium onion, chopped
2 cups beef broth
2 cups elbow macaroni
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1 cup milk
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Instructions:
Brown the Beef:
In a large pot, cook the ground beef and chopped onion over medium heat until the beef is fully browned. Drain any excess grease to keep things light and flavorful.
Add the Broth and Macaroni:
Pour in the beef broth and bring it to a boil. Stir in the elbow macaroni and simmer until its just tender, about 7-8 minutes.
Cheese It Up:
Reduce the heat, then slowly stir in the milk and cheddar cheese. Keep stirring until the cheese melts completely, giving the soup a rich, creamy texture.
Season and Serve:
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve it hot, and dont forgetyou can always top it with a bit of extra shredded cheddar or a sprinkle of parsley for a finishing touch.
Prep Time: 10 mins  Total Time: 30 mins  Servings: 6

Message:
Crispy Batter Dipped Fried Fish Recipe 
Ingredients:
4-6 white fish fillets cod, haddock, or tilapia
1 cup all-purpose flour
1/4 cup cornstarch
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1/2 teaspoon paprika
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1/2 teaspoon onion powder
1 egg
1 cup cold water or club soda for extra crunch
Vegetable oil for frying
Instructions:
1. Prep the Fish:
Pat the fish fillets dry using paper towels to remove moisture, ensuring the batter sticks well.
2. Make the Batter:
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
In a small bowl, beat the egg and stir it into the dry mix. Gradually add cold water or club soda for extra crispiness while whisking until the batter is smooth and resembles pancake batter.
3. Fry the Fish:
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350F 175C.
Dip each fish fillet into the batter, making sure they are fully coated, and gently place them into the hot oil.
Fry 2-3 fillets at a time, cooking for 4-5 minutes per side, until the fish is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fillets with a slotted spoon and let them drain on a paper towel-lined plate.
4. Serve:
Serve immediately with tartar sauce or lemon wedges. For a traditional fish and chips vibe, pair with fries, coleslaw, or hush puppies.

Description:
Crispy Batter Dipped Fried Fish Recipe 
Ingredients:
4-6 white fish fillets cod, haddock, or tilapia
1 cup all-purpose flour
1/4 cup cornstarch
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1/2 teaspoon paprika
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1/2 teaspoon onion powder
1 egg
1 cup cold water or club soda for extra crunch
Vegetable oil for frying
Instructions:
1. Prep the Fish:
Pat the fish fillets dry using paper towels to remove moisture, ensuring the batter sticks well.
2. Make the Batter:
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
In a small bowl, beat the egg and stir it into the dry mix. Gradually add cold water or club soda for extra crispiness while whisking until the batter is smooth and resembles pancake batter.
3. Fry the Fish:
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350F 175C.
Dip each fish fillet into the batter, making sure they are fully coated, and gently place them into the hot oil.
Fry 2-3 fillets at a time, cooking for 4-5 minutes per side, until the fish is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fillets with a slotted spoon and let them drain on a paper towel-lined plate.
4. Serve:
Serve immediately with tartar sauce or lemon wedges. For a traditional fish and chips vibe, pair with fries, coleslaw, or hush puppies.
Enjoy your perfectly crispy, golden fried fish!

Creamy Chicken Bundles 
Ingredients:
3 cups shredded cooked chicken rotisserie chicken works great!
8 ounces cream cheese, softened
10.5 ounces cream of chicken soup
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes
 teaspoon black pepper
 teaspoon kosher salt
 teaspoon garlic powder
 teaspoon onion powder
2 cans crescent roll dough
2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 375F 190C.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly grease it.
Prepare the Filling:
In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, softened cream cheese, cream of chicken soup, grated Parmesan, parsley flakes, black pepper, salt, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Mix until everything is well combined and creamy.
Prepare the Crescent Rolls:
Open the crescent roll dough and separate it into individual triangles.
Fill the Crescents:
Place a generous spoonful of the chicken mixture at the wide end of each crescent roll triangle.
Roll up the dough from the wide end, tucking the ends underneath to form a neat bundle.
Arrange the chicken bundles on the prepared baking sheet.
Brush with Butter:
Brush the tops of the chicken bundles with the melted butter for added flavor and to promote browning.
Bake:
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the crescent rolls are golden brown and fully cooked.
Serve:
Remove from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving.
Enjoy these creamy and delicious chicken bundles warm!
Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 15 minutes
Total Time: 30 minutes
Calories: 350 kcal per serving
Servings: 8 servings

Message:
Butternut Squash-Stuffed Turkey Tenderloin 
Ingredients:
1 lb turkey tenderloin
2 teaspoons olive oil
1 small onion, diced
1  cups butternut squash, peeled and cubed small
2 garlic cloves, minced
 cup dried cranberries
 cup reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled
2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
Salt and pepper, to taste
Kitchen string for tying
Directions:
Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 375F 190C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly grease it.
Cook the Squash: Heat 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced onion and butternut squash, cooking for about 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the squash is soft. Add the garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add Cranberries and Feta: Remove the skillet from heat and stir in the dried cranberries, crumbled feta, and fresh parsley. Season the filling with salt and pepper to taste. Let it cool slightly.
Prepare the Turkey: Slice the turkey tenderloin lengthwise, creating a pocket without cutting all the way through. Lay the tenderloin open and pound it lightly with a meat mallet to an even thickness. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Stuff the Turkey: Spoon the butternut squash mixture evenly into the turkey tenderloin, then fold the turkey over to enclose the stuffing. Use kitchen string to tie the tenderloin at 2-inch intervals, securing the stuffing inside.
Sear the Turkey: Heat the remaining teaspoon of olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the stuffed turkey and sear for about 3 minutes on each side until browned.
Roast the Turkey: Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the turkey for about 25-30 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165F 74C. Let the turkey rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve: Slice the turkey into rounds and serve alongside your favorite side dishes for a festive and delicious meal!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 35 minutes  Total Time: 50 minutes
 Kcal: 225 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings

Message:
Merry Christmas Jam 
Ingredients:
2 cups strawberries, hulled and chopped
2 cups cranberries fresh or frozen
4 cups granulated sugar
1/2 cup orange juice
1/4 cup water
1 tbsp grated orange zest
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground cloves
1 1.75 oz package fruit pectin
Directions:
1 Prepare the Fruit:
In a large pot, combine the chopped strawberries, cranberries, orange juice, and water. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce the heat and let it simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the cranberries burst and the mixture softens.
2 Add the Pectin:
Stir in the fruit pectin and bring the mixture to a full rolling boil one that doesnt stop bubbling when stirred. Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
3 Add Sugar and Spices:
Gradually stir in the sugar until it dissolves. Add the orange zest, cinnamon, and cloves. Return the mixture to a rolling boil and cook for another minute, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
4 Fill the Jars:
Skim off any foam on the surface, then ladle the hot jam into sterilized jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Wipe the rims clean, apply lids, and screw the rings on just until finger-tight.
5 Process in a Water Bath:
Place the jars in a boiling water bath and process for 10 minutes. Remove the jars and allow them to cool completely. Check the seals after 24 hours.
Nutritional Information:
Calories: Approx. 45 per tablespoon
Yields: About 6 half-pint jars
Enjoy this flavorful jam on toast, scones, or as a thoughtful homemade gift!

Message:
Peanut Butter Spider Cookies 
Ingredients:
 cup unsalted butter, softened
 cup creamy peanut butter
 cup granulated sugar
 cup packed brown sugar
1 large egg
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1  cups all-purpose flour
 teaspoon baking soda
 teaspoon baking powder
 teaspoon salt
24 miniature chocolate peanut butter cups, unwrapped
48 candy eyes
Melted chocolate for spider legs
Directions:
Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 375F 190C. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone mats.
Mix Wet Ingredients: In a large bowl, beat together the softened butter, peanut butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, egg, and vanilla extract until light and fluffy.
Add Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the dry mixture into the wet ingredients, mixing on low until a dough forms.
Shape the Dough: Roll the dough into 1-inch balls and place them on the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake the Cookies: Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden. Remove the cookies from the oven and immediately press a miniature peanut butter cup into the center of each cookie. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
Decorate with Candy Eyes: While the peanut butter cups are still soft, press two candy eyes into the top of each peanut butter cup to resemble spider eyes.
Draw the Spider Legs: Once the cookies are completely cool, use melted chocolate to draw eight spider legs around the peanut butter cup on each cookie.
Serve: Let the chocolate set, and your spooky spider cookies are ready to serve!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
 Kcal: 180 kcal per cookie   Servings: 24 cookies
#PeanutButterCookies #SpiderCookies #HalloweenBaking #FunRecipes #HalloweenDesserts

Message:
Minty Chocolate Bliss Cheesecake Cake: A Show-Stopping Dessert! 
柳 Ingredients 柳
For the Chocolate Cake:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 cup vegetable oil
2 large eggs
1 cup buttermilk
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
For the Mint Cheesecake Filling:
1 cup cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup sour cream

1/2 cup heavy cream
1 tbsp powdered sugar

Fresh mint leaves

Message:
Chocolate Monster Cookies 
Ingredients:
1 cup salted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
1 cup packed brown sugar
1 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter
3 large eggs
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
4 1/2 cups old-fashioned rolled oats
2 teaspoons baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 cup M&Ms candies
1 cup chopped pecans optional
Directions:
Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Mix the Wet Ingredients: In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the peanut butter, eggs, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Prepare the Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl, combine the oats, baking soda, and salt.
Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing until just combined.
Add Mix-ins: Fold in the chocolate chips, M&Ms candies, and chopped pecans if using.
Form Cookies: Scoop out the dough about 2 tablespoons per cookie and place it on the prepared baking sheets, leaving enough space between each cookie.
Bake: Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden but the center is still soft. The cookies will continue to set as they cool.
Cool: Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. Enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 12 minutes  Total Time: 27 minutes
 Kcal: 260 kcal per cookie   Servings: 36 cookies

Message:
Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie 
Ingredients:
1 unbaked 9-inch pie crust
1 cup granulated sugar
1 cup packed brown sugar
1 cup 2 sticks unsalted butter, softened
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 cup all-purpose flour
 teaspoon baking powder
 teaspoon salt
1  cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 cup chopped nuts optional - walnuts or pecans
Directions:
Preheat Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Place the pie crust in a 9-inch pie plate and set it aside.
Cream the Butter and Sugars:
In a large mixing bowl, beat the granulated sugar, brown sugar, and softened butter together until creamy and smooth.
Add Eggs and Vanilla:
Beat in the eggs one at a time, making sure to mix well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Mix Dry Ingredients:
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add this dry mixture to the wet ingredients, stirring until just combined.
Add Chocolate and Nuts:
Fold in the chocolate chips and, if desired, the chopped nuts.
Fill and Bake:
Spread the cookie dough evenly into the prepared pie crust. Bake for 55-60 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool and Serve:
Let the pie cool on a wire rack before slicing. Serve warm or at room temperature.
Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 55-60 minutes
Total Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Servings: 8 slices
Enjoy your deliciously gooey Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie!

Message:
Giant Reeses Peanut Butter Cup Pie
Ingredients:
1 pre-baked pie crust
1 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter
1 1/2 cups powdered sugar
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 cup heavy whipping cream
2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2 cup heavy cream for ganache
Assorted Reeses candies like Reeses Pieces or Mini Reeses Cups for topping
Directions:
Prepare the Peanut Butter Filling:
In a large bowl, combine peanut butter, powdered sugar, and softened cream cheese. Mix until smooth and creamy.
Whip the Cream:
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the whipped cream into the peanut butter mixture until fully combined.
Assemble the Pie:
Spread the peanut butter mixture evenly into the pre-baked pie crust, smoothing the surface with a spatula.
Make the Ganache:
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and 1/2 cup of heavy cream. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until the chocolate is fully melted and smooth.
Top with Ganache:
Pour the chocolate ganache over the peanut butter filling, spreading it evenly to cover the top of the pie.
Decorate:
Add assorted Reeses candies on top for decoration.
Chill and Set:
Refrigerate the pie for at least 4 hours until fully set.
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 4 hours 20 minutes
Servings: 8
Calories: 600 kcal per slice
Enjoy your indulgent Reeses Peanut Butter Cup Pie!

Message:
Pineapple Teriyaki Shrimp Rice Bowl
Ingredients:
For the Shrimp:
1 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/4 cup teriyaki sauce
1/4 cup pineapple juice
1 tablespoon rice vinegar
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon ginger powder
For the Rice:
7. 1 cup sushi rice
8. 1 1/2 cups water
For the Pineapple Salsa:
9. 1 mango, diced
10. 1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped
11. 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped
12. 1 tablespoon lime juice
13. 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
Directions:
Cook the Rice:
Prepare the sushi rice according to package instructions, using the water.
Marinate the Shrimp:
In a bowl, mix the shrimp with teriyaki sauce, pineapple juice, rice vinegar, garlic powder, and ginger powder. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the Shrimp:
Grill or pan-sear the marinated shrimp until fully cooked.
Prepare the Pineapple Salsa:
In a small bowl, combine diced mango, red onion, cilantro, lime juice, and chili powder. Mix until well blended.
Assemble the Bowl:
Place a scoop of cooked rice in a bowl or plate. Top with the cooked shrimp and a generous amount of pineapple salsa. Add optional toppings like avocado, sesame seeds, or pickled ginger if desired.
Serve and Enjoy:
Your Pineapple Teriyaki Shrimp Rice Bowl is ready to be enjoyed!
Tips:
For more heat, increase the chili powder in the marinade or salsa.
Substitute sushi rice with brown rice or quinoa for a healthier option.
Serve with soy sauce or wasabi on the side for added flavor.

Message:
Nacho Cheese Beef Wraps
Ingredients:
1 pound lean ground beef
1 cup nacho cheese sauce
1/2 cup sour cream
1 can Rotel green chilies with diced tomatoes
1/2 cup chopped green peppers
1/2 cup diced onions
1 packet taco seasoning mix
Nacho cheese-flavored Doritos, crushed
4 large flour tortillas
Shredded lettuce
Instructions:
Cook the Beef:
In a skillet, brown the ground beef over medium heat. Drain any excess fat.
Sauté Vegetables:
Add the diced onions and chopped green peppers to the skillet and sauté for about 4 minutes, until softened.
Season the Beef:
Stir in the taco seasoning mix and combine well with the beef and vegetables.
Prepare Cheese Mixture:
In a separate bowl, mix the Rotel and nacho cheese sauce until smooth.
Assemble the Wraps:
Lay out the tortillas on a flat surface. Spoon a layer of the nacho cheese mixture down the center of each tortilla, followed by the beef mixture. Add sour cream, extra onions and peppers, and a handful of crushed Doritos on top.
Wrap and Toast:
Fold in the sides of each tortilla and roll them tightly like a burrito. Heat a skillet over medium heat and toast the wraps on both sides until crispy.
Serve:
Serve immediately with shredded lettuce and any additional toppings of your choice.
Enjoy these delicious, cheesy beef wraps!

Message:
Strawberry Crunch Cheesecake
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
For the Cream Cheese Layer:
2 cups cream cheese, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 cups heavy cream, whipped
For the Strawberry Mousse Layer:
1 cup strawberry preserves
1/2 cup freeze-dried strawberries, crushed
1/2 cup vanilla wafer crumbs
For the Topping:
Fresh strawberries for garnish
Instructions:
Prepare the Crust:
In a medium bowl, mix the graham cracker crumbs and melted butter until well combined. Press this mixture firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Chill in the fridge while you prepare the filling.
Make the Cream Cheese Layer:
In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy. Gently fold in the whipped heavy cream. Spread half of this cream cheese mixture evenly over the crust.
Add the Strawberry Mousse Layer:
Spread the strawberry preserves over the cream cheese layer. Add the remaining cream cheese mixture on top, smoothing it out evenly. In a small bowl, combine the crushed freeze-dried strawberries and vanilla wafer crumbs, and sprinkle this over the top of the cheesecake.
Garnish and Chill:
Garnish with fresh strawberries on top. Cover the cheesecake and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or until fully set.
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Chill Time: 4 hours
Total Time: 4 hours 20 minutes
Calories: 450 kcal
Servings: 8 servings

Crockpot Pizza Burgers
Ingredients:
2 lbs ground beef
30 oz pizza sauce two 15 oz jars
1/2 cup pepperoni slices, cut in half
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
8 slices mozzarella cheese
8 rolls
Instructions:
Brown the Beef:
In a skillet, brown the ground beef over medium heat, then drain any excess fat. Transfer the cooked beef to the bottom of your slow cooker.
Add Sauce and Pepperoni:
Stir in the pizza sauce and halved pepperoni slices. Cover and set the slow cooker to low. Cook for 3 hours.

Serve the hearty pizza mixture on rolls, adding a slice of mozzarella cheese on top of each.

Message:
Sweet and Crunchy Praline Party Mix
Ingredients:
3 cups Corn Chex cereal
3 cups Rice Chex cereal
3 cups Crispix cereal
2 cups pretzels
2 cups pecan halves
1 cup unsalted butter
1 cup light brown sugar
 teaspoon salt
Instructions:
Mix the Dry Ingredients:
In a large bowl, combine the Corn Chex, Rice Chex, Crispix, pretzels, and pecans. Toss gently to ensure even distribution.
Prepare the Praline Coating:
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the brown sugar and salt, stirring frequently. Bring the mixture to a boil and let it bubble for 1-2 minutes.
Coat the Mix:
Pour the hot praline mixture over the cereal and pretzel blend. Toss gently to ensure that everything is evenly coated.
Bake and Stir:
Spread the coated mixture evenly onto a rimmed baking sheet. Bake at 250F 120C for 10 minutes, then remove and stir.
Continue Baking:
Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes to ensure even cooking.
Cool and Store:
Once baked, allow the mix to cool completely. Store in an airtight container to maintain freshness.

Message:
Autumn Pumpkin Spice Crumble Cake
Ingredients:
For the Crumble Topping:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 cup packed light brown sugar
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
 teaspoon ground nutmeg
 teaspoon salt
 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
For the Pumpkin Spice Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour
3 teaspoons baking powder
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
 teaspoon ground ginger
 teaspoon ground nutmeg
 teaspoon ground cloves
1 cups pumpkin puree not pumpkin pie filling
 cup vegetable oil
2 cups granulated sugar
2 large eggs, at room temperature
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup buttermilk or milk with 1 teaspoon lemon juice/vinegar
For the Vanilla Drizzle:
1 cup powdered sugar
2 tablespoons milk
 teaspoon vanilla extract
Instructions:
Prepare the Crumble Topping:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and grease a 9x9-inch or 9x13-inch baking pan. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Use a pastry cutter or your hands to cut the cold butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Set aside.
Make the Pumpkin Spice Cake:
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cloves. In a separate bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, vegetable oil, and sugar until smooth. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, then stir in the vanilla extract. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the pumpkin mixture, alternating with the buttermilk, stirring until just combined.
Assemble & Bake:
Pour the cake batter into the prepared pan, spreading it evenly. Sprinkle the crumble topping over the cake batter and gently press it into the surface. Bake for 30-35 minutes for a 9x9 pan or 20-25 minutes for a 9x13 pan, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs. Allow the cake to cool slightly in the pan.
Prepare the Vanilla Drizzle:
In a small bowl, whisk together the powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Drizzle the mixture over the warm cake for an added touch of sweetness.
Serve & Enjoy:
Slice and serve the cake warm or at room temperature. Savor the cozy fall flavors with every bite!

Message:
Shredded Chicken Gravy on Mashed Potatoes
Ingredients:
2 cans cream of chicken soup
2 cans water
2 packets chicken gravy mix
2 packs of chicken breast
Mashed potatoes store-bought or homemade, prepared with butter
Instructions:
Prepare the Crockpot:
In a crockpot, combine the cream of chicken soup, water, and chicken gravy packets.
Season the Chicken:
Season the chicken breasts with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Cook the Chicken:
Place the seasoned chicken breasts in the crockpot. Cook on low for 7-8 hours until tender.
Shred the Chicken:
Once cooked, remove the chicken from the crockpot and shred it using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the crockpot and stir to combine.
Serve:
Serve the shredded chicken and gravy over a bed of mashed potatoes. Rolls pair nicely with this dish.

Message:
Country Apple Fritter Bread
Ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
 cup granulated sugar
 cup light brown sugar
 teaspoon salt
 teaspoon baking powder
 teaspoon ground cinnamon
2 large eggs
 cup unsalted butter, melted
 cup milk
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 large apples, peeled, cored, and chopped
 cup granulated sugar for apples
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon for apples
Glaze:
1 cup powdered sugar
2-3 tablespoons milk
 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Combine Dry Ingredients:
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, salt, baking powder, and ground cinnamon.
Mix Wet Ingredients:
In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla extract. Add this mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Prepare the Apples:
In a small bowl, toss the chopped apples with  cup granulated sugar and 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon.
Layer the Batter:
Pour half of the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Layer with half of the apple mixture, then pour the remaining batter over the apples. Top with the remaining apple mixture and lightly press the apples into the batter.
Bake:
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool:
Allow the bread to cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
Make the Glaze:
In a small bowl, whisk together the powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Drizzle the glaze over the cooled bread.
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 60 minutes
Total Time: 80 minutes
Calories: 320 kcal per serving
Servings: 8 servings

Message:
Gingerbread Cookie Bars 
Ingredients:
For the Gingerbread Bars:
2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
2 teaspoons ground ginger
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
1/2 teaspoon salt
3/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
1 large egg
1/4 cup molasses
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 tablespoon spiced rum optional
For the Frosting:
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
2 cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 tablespoon heavy cream more if needed
Sprinkles or cinnamon sugar optional, for garnish
Directions:
Preheat and Prepare Pan: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease or line a 9x13-inch baking pan with parchment paper.
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and salt. Set aside.
Cream Butter and Sugars: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add the egg, molasses, vanilla extract, and spiced rum if using. Beat until smooth and fully combined.
Combine Wet and Dry: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing until a soft dough forms. Spread the dough evenly into the prepared baking pan, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Bake the Bars: Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. The edges should be slightly golden, but the center can be soft. Let the bars cool completely in the pan.
Prepare the Frosting: While the bars are cooling, prepare the frosting by beating the softened butter in a bowl until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar, then mix in the vanilla extract and heavy cream. Beat until the frosting is smooth and fluffy, adding more cream if needed for spreadability.
Frost and Garnish: Once the bars have cooled, spread the frosting evenly over the top. Optionally, sprinkle with festive sprinkles or a dusting of cinnamon sugar.
Cut and Serve: Slice the gingerbread cookie bars into squares and enjoy! These rich, spiced bars are perfect for holiday parties or as a cozy winter treat.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 15 minutes  Baking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
 Kcal: 250 kcal per bar   Servings: 16 bars

Message:
Roasted Cranberry and Goat Cheese Flatbread 
Ingredients:
1 pre-made pizza dough or flatbread base
1 cup fresh cranberries
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 tablespoon honey
1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
4 ounces goat cheese, crumbled
1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/4 teaspoon dried thyme
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped
1/4 cup walnuts, chopped optional
Arugula or baby greens for garnish
Directions:
Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 400F 200C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a lightly greased baking tray.
Roast the Cranberries: In a small bowl, toss the fresh cranberries with olive oil, honey, and balsamic vinegar. Spread them evenly on the prepared baking sheet and roast in the oven for about 10 minutes, or until they start to burst and become slightly soft.
Prepare the Flatbread: Roll out your pizza dough or use a pre-made flatbread. Place it on a separate baking sheet. Brush the top with a little olive oil to help it crisp up in the oven.
Assemble the Flatbread: Scatter the roasted cranberries evenly over the flatbread. Add the crumbled goat cheese and shredded mozzarella cheese on top. Sprinkle with dried thyme, black pepper, and fresh rosemary. If using, sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the flatbread for an added crunch.
Bake the Flatbread: Place the assembled flatbread in the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly, and the crust is golden brown.
Add Fresh Greens and Serve: Once out of the oven, garnish the flatbread with fresh arugula or baby greens for a pop of color and freshness. Slice and serve immediately.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
 Kcal: 280 kcal per slice   Servings: 6 slices

Message:
Beary Delicious Peanut Butter Paw Prints
Ingredients:
 cup unsalted butter, softened
 cup creamy peanut butter
 cup granulated sugar
 cup packed brown sugar
1 large egg
2 tablespoons milk
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1  cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
 teaspoon salt
Additional granulated sugar for rolling
48 chocolate chips
Instructions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 375F 190C and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Cream the Mixture:
In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, peanut butter,  cup granulated sugar, and brown sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy.
Add Wet Ingredients:
Beat in the egg, milk, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Combine Dry Ingredients:
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing until just combined.
Shape the Cookies:
Roll the dough into 1-inch balls and then coat them in additional granulated sugar. Place the balls 2 inches apart on the prepared baking sheets.
Create Paw Prints:
Using the back of a spoon, make four indentations in each cookie to form a paw print shape.
Bake:
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are lightly browned.
Add Chocolate Chips:
Remove from the oven and immediately press one chocolate chip in the center of each cookie, along with three more for the ""toes"" of the paw print.
Cool:
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes before transferring them to wire racks to cool completely.
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 12 minutes
Total Time: 32 minutes
Calories: 120 kcal per cookie
Servings: 24 cookies

Message:
泌燎 Mozzarella-Stuffed Rosemary Parmesan Soft Pretzels 燎泌
Ingredients:
1 1/2 cups warm water 110F
1 packet 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
1 tablespoon granulated sugar
4 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon salt
2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
8 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into cubes
For the Baking Soda Bath:
1/2 cup baking soda
9 cups water
For Topping:
1 egg, beaten for egg wash
1 tablespoon coarse sea salt
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped
Directions:
Activate the Yeast: In a large bowl, combine the warm water, sugar, and yeast. Let it sit for about 5 minutes until the yeast becomes foamy.
Make the Dough: Add the flour, salt, rosemary, grated Parmesan, and melted butter to the yeast mixture. Stir to combine, then knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the Dough Rise: Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with a towel, and let it rise in a warm spot for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Prepare the Baking Soda Bath: While the dough is rising, bring 9 cups of water and the baking soda to a boil in a large pot. Preheat your oven to 425F 220C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Shape the Pretzels: Once the dough has risen, punch it down and divide it into 8 equal pieces. Flatten each piece into a rectangle, place a cube of mozzarella in the center, and wrap the dough around it, sealing the edges tightly. Roll each piece into a long rope and shape into a traditional pretzel.
Baking Soda Dip: Dip each pretzel into the boiling baking soda bath for about 20-30 seconds. Remove with a slotted spoon and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Add Toppings: Brush each pretzel with the beaten egg wash. Sprinkle the tops with coarse sea salt, Parmesan, and additional rosemary.
Bake the Pretzels: Bake the pretzels for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. The cheese inside should be melted and gooey.
Serve Warm: Enjoy these soft, cheesy pretzels warm, straight from the oven, as a savory snack or appetizer!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Rise Time: 1 hour  Cooking Time: 15 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 35 minutes
 Kcal: 290 kcal per pretzel   Servings: 8 pretzels

Message:
Gingerbread Crinkle Cookie Sandwiches with Vanilla Bean Frosting 
Ingredients:
For the Gingerbread Crinkle Cookies:
2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
2 teaspoons ground ginger
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/4 teaspoon salt
3/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup molasses
1 large egg
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/4 cup granulated sugar for rolling
1/4 cup powdered sugar for rolling
1 tablespoon spiced rum optional
For the Vanilla Bean Frosting:
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
2 cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract
2 tablespoons heavy cream
Directions:
Preheat and Prepare: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and salt.
Make the Cookie Dough: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and brown sugar together until light and fluffy. Add the molasses, egg, and vanilla extract and spiced rum if using. Mix until well combined. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Chill the Dough: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. This helps the dough firm up and makes it easier to roll.
Shape and Coat: Roll chilled dough into 1-inch balls. Roll each ball in granulated sugar first, then in powdered sugar to give them the signature crinkle effect.
Bake the Cookies: Place the sugar-coated dough balls onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes, until the edges are set but the centers are still soft. Let the cookies cool completely on a wire rack.
Prepare the Frosting: In a mixing bowl, beat the softened butter until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar, mixing on low speed. Once combined, add the vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract and heavy cream. Beat until the frosting is smooth and fluffy.
Assemble the Sandwiches: Once the cookies are cool, spread or pipe the vanilla bean frosting onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie to form a sandwich. Repeat with the remaining cookies.
Serve and Enjoy: These gingerbread crinkle cookie sandwiches are perfect for holiday gatherings or as a cozy treat with a cup of tea!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Chill Time: 1 hour  Baking Time: 12 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 32 minutes
 Kcal: 210 kcal per sandwich   Servings: 12 sandwiches

Assemble the Sandwiches: Once the cookies are cool, spread or pipe the vanilla bean frosting onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie to form a sandwich. Repeat with the remaining cookies.
Serve and Enjoy: These gingerbread crinkle cookie sandwiches are perfect for holiday gatherings or as a cozy treat with a cup of tea!

Message:
No-Bake Pumpkin Cheesecake Balls 
Ingredients:
8 ounces cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup pumpkin puree
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs divided
1/2 cup white chocolate chips optional, for coating
Directions:
Mix the Filling: In a medium bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth. Add the pumpkin puree, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, pumpkin pie spice, and cinnamon. Continue to mix until fully combined and creamy.
Add Graham Cracker Crumbs: Stir in 1 cup of graham cracker crumbs into the pumpkin mixture. This will help thicken the mixture so its easier to shape into balls.
Chill the Mixture: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. This will firm up the mixture, making it easier to roll.
Shape into Balls: Once chilled, scoop out tablespoon-sized portions of the mixture and roll them into balls. Place the balls on a lined baking sheet.
Coat the Balls: Roll each ball in the remaining 1/2 cup of graham cracker crumbs until fully coated. For a more decadent option, you can melt the white chocolate chips and dip each ball for a smooth, sweet coating.
Chill Again: Place the coated pumpkin cheesecake balls in the refrigerator for another 30 minutes to set.
Serve and Enjoy: Once firm, serve these delicious no-bake pumpkin cheesecake balls straight from the fridge. They make a perfect bite-sized fall treat!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 10 minutes  Chill Time: 1 hour  Total Time: 1 hour 10 minutes
 Kcal: 120 kcal per ball   Servings: 24 balls

Message:
Pumpkin Pie French Toast with Homemade Pumpkin Syrup 丹
Ingredients:
For the French Toast:
4 large eggs
1 cup milk
1 cup canned pumpkin puree
1 tablespoon sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
 teaspoon ground cinnamon
8 slices of thick bread preferably Texas toast
For the Homemade Pumpkin Syrup:
1 cup maple syrup
 cup canned pumpkin puree
1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
 teaspoon ground cinnamon
Instructions:
Make the Pumpkin Pie French Toast Mixture:
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, pumpkin puree, sugar, vanilla extract, pumpkin pie spice, and ground cinnamon until smooth.
Soak the Bread:
Dip each slice of bread into the pumpkin mixture, ensuring both sides are well-coated and soaked for a few seconds.
Cook the French Toast:
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it with butter or non-stick spray. Cook the soaked bread slices for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they turn golden brown.
Prepare the Homemade Pumpkin Syrup:
In a saucepan, combine the maple syrup, pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice, and ground cinnamon. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally until warmed through.
Serve:
Serve the French toast warm, drizzled with the homemade pumpkin syrup. Optionally, sprinkle with powdered sugar or extra cinnamon for garnish. Enjoy!
