Message:
Whipped Chocolate Cheesecake Parfaits 
Ingredients:
Crust:
- 1 cup chocolate cookie crumbs
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
Chocolate Cheesecake Filling:
- 8 oz cream cheese, softened
-  cup powdered sugar
-  cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1  cups heavy whipping cream
Whipped Cream Topping:
- 1 cup heavy whipping cream
- 2 tablespoons powdered sugar
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Toppings:
- Shaved chocolate or chocolate chips for garnish
Directions:
1. Prepare the crust: In a small bowl, mix the chocolate cookie crumbs with the melted butter until well combined. Set aside.
2. Make the chocolate cheesecake filling: In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth. Add the powdered sugar, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract, and beat until well incorporated.
3. Whip the cream: In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture until fully combined and fluffy.
4. Assemble the parfaits: Spoon 1-2 tablespoons of the chocolate cookie crumb mixture into the bottom of each serving glass. Add a layer of chocolate cheesecake filling on top of the crumbs. Repeat the layers if desired, ending with the cheesecake filling.
5. Prepare the whipped cream topping: In a clean bowl, whip the heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until soft peaks form.
6. Top the parfaits: Pipe or spoon the whipped cream on top of the cheesecake layers. Garnish with shaved chocolate or chocolate chips.
7. Chill and serve: Refrigerate the parfaits for at least 1 hour to set. Serve chilled and enjoy these creamy, chocolatey treats!

Message:
The Best Chocolate Cookie Dough Cake 
Ingredients:
Chocolate Cake:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 cups granulated sugar
-  cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1  tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 cup buttermilk, room temperature
-  cup vegetable oil
- 2 large eggs, room temperature
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup boiling water
Edible Cookie Dough:
-  cup unsalted butter, softened
-  cup brown sugar
-  cup granulated sugar
- 2 tbsp milk
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1  cups all-purpose flour, heat-treated
-  cup mini chocolate chips
Chocolate Buttercream:
- 1  cups unsalted butter, softened
- 3  cups powdered sugar
-  cup unsweetened cocoa powder
-  cup heavy cream
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt
Toppings:
-  cup mini chocolate chips
- Chocolate ganache optional
- Cookie dough balls for garnish
Directions:
1. Preheat the oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and line three 8-inch round cake pans with parchment paper.
2. Make the chocolate cake: In a large bowl, sift together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla extract. Slowly add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, mixing until combined. Gradually stir in the boiling water. The batter will be thin.
3. Bake the cakes: Divide the batter evenly among the prepared pans. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
4. Prepare the edible cookie dough: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Mix in the milk and vanilla extract. Gradually add the heat-treated flour and beat until smooth. Fold in the mini chocolate chips. Roll some dough into small balls for garnish, and set aside the rest.
5. Make the chocolate buttercream: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar and cocoa powder, alternating with the heavy cream. Add vanilla extract and a pinch of salt, then beat until the frosting is light and fluffy.
6. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate and spread a layer of chocolate buttercream on top. Drop spoonfuls of cookie dough over the frosting and lightly spread them out. Repeat with the second cake layer. Place the final cake layer on top and frost the entire cake with the remaining buttercream.
7. Decorate: Press mini chocolate chips around the sides of the cake. Drizzle chocolate ganache on top, if desired, and garnish with cookie dough balls.
8. Chill and serve: Refrigerate the cake for 30 minutes before serving to set the layers. Slice and enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 40 minutes  Cooking Time: 35 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
-  Kcal: 650 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings
#ChocolateCookieDoughCake #ChocolateDesserts #CakeLovers #CookieDoughLovers #DecadentTreats

Message:
Black Forest Roll Cake 
Ingredients:
Chocolate Sponge Cake:
- 4 large eggs, room temperature
-  cup granulated sugar
-  cup all-purpose flour
-  cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 tsp baking powder
-  tsp salt
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
Cherry Filling:
- 1 cup cherry pie filling or fresh cherries, pitted and chopped
- 2 tbsp cherry syrup from the filling or cherry juice
Whipped Cream:
- 1  cups heavy whipping cream, cold
-  cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
Topping:
- 1 cup whipped cream extra for decorating
- Shaved dark chocolate for garnish
- Fresh cherries for garnish
Directions:
1. Preheat the oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and line a 10x15 inch 25x38 cm baking pan with parchment paper.
2. Prepare the chocolate sponge cake: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and sugar on high speed for 5-6 minutes, until light, fluffy, and tripled in volume. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. Gently fold the dry ingredients into the egg mixture until just combined. Add the oil and vanilla extract, folding gently.

5. Prepare the whipped cream: In a large bowl, whip the cold heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Set aside.
6. Assemble the roll cake: Unroll the cooled sponge cake. Spread a thin layer of cherry syrup over the surface. 7. Decorate the cake: Spread a layer of whipped cream over the roll cake. Garnish with shaved dark chocolate and fresh cherries for a classic Black Forest look.
8. Chill and serve: Refrigerate the cake for at least 1 hour before slicing to allow the flavors to meld. Serve chilled and enjoy this delightful Black Forest Roll Cake!

Message:
Chocolate Chip Cookie Ice Cream Cake 
Ingredients:
Crust:
- 2  cups chocolate chip cookie crumbs about 20 cookies
- 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
Ice Cream Layer:
- 1.5 quarts vanilla ice cream, softened
- 1  cups chocolate chip cookies, chopped about 10 cookies
Whipped Cream:
- 2 cups heavy whipping cream
-  cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
Toppings:
- Chocolate sauce
- Extra chocolate chip cookies whole or crushed, for garnish
Directions:
1. Prepare the crust: Line the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, combine the chocolate chip cookie crumbs and melted butter. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of the pan to form the crust. Freeze for 10-15 minutes to set.
2. Add the ice cream layer: In a large bowl, mix the softened vanilla ice cream with the chopped chocolate chip cookies. Spread the ice cream mixture evenly over the crust. Smooth the top and freeze for 4-6 hours, or until firm.
3. Make the whipped cream: In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract on high speed until stiff peaks form.
4. Assemble the cake: Once the ice cream layer is frozen, remove the cake from the freezer and spread a thick layer of whipped cream on top. Smooth the surface evenly.
5. Decorate: Drizzle the top with chocolate sauce and garnish with whole or crushed chocolate chip cookies. Return the cake to the freezer for at least 30 minutes before serving to ensure everything is set.
6. Serve: Remove the cake from the springform pan, slice, and enjoy this refreshing and indulgent dessert!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 25 minutes  Freezing Time: 6 hours  Total Time: 6 hours 25 minutes
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings

Message:
Easy Chocolate Cake 
Ingredients:
- 1  cups all-purpose flour
-  cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1  tsp baking powder
- 1  tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 cup whole milk
-  cup vegetable oil
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup boiling water
Chocolate Frosting:
- 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 3  cups powdered sugar
-  cup unsweetened cocoa powder
-  cup heavy cream more if needed
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
Directions:
1. Preheat the oven: Preheat your oven to 350F. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans, or line the bottoms with parchment paper.
2. Mix dry ingredients: In a large bowl, sift together the flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar.
3. Combine wet ingredients: In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract until smooth.
4. Mix batter: Slowly add the wet ingredients to the dry mixture, mixing until just combined. Stir in the boiling water. The batter will be thinthis helps create a moist cake.
5. Bake the cakes: Pour the batter evenly into the prepared cake pans. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
6. Prepare the frosting: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar and cocoa powder, alternating with heavy cream. Add the vanilla extract and beat on high until light and fluffy. If needed, add more cream to reach your desired consistency.
7. Frost the cake: Once the cakes are completely cool, place one layer on a serving plate. Spread a thick layer of frosting on top, then add the second layer. Frost the top and sides of the cake with the remaining frosting.
8. Serve: Slice and enjoy your rich, moist chocolate cake!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 35 minutes  Total Time: 50 minutes
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings

Message:
Chocolate Pecan Cake 
Ingredients:
Cake:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 2 large eggs
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup boiling water
Pecan Filling:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup brown sugar
- 1/4 cup heavy cream
- 1 cup chopped pecans
- 1/4 cup bourbon or dark rum optional
Chocolate Frosting:
- 1 1/2 cups unsalted butter, softened
- 4 cups powdered sugar
- 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/4 cup milk
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
Directions:
1. Preheat the oven: Preheat your oven to 350F. Grease and flour three 9-inch round cake pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
2. Mix the dry ingredients: In a large bowl, sift together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
3. Combine wet ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, vegetable oil, eggs, and vanilla extract. Gradually add this mixture to the dry ingredients, mixing until well combined.
4. Add boiling water: Slowly stir in the boiling water until the batter is smooth. The batter will be thinthis is normal.
5. Bake the cakes: Divide the batter evenly among the prepared cake pans. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
6. Prepare the pecan filling: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Stir in the brown sugar and heavy cream, cooking until smooth. Remove from heat and mix in the chopped pecans and bourbon if using. Let the filling cool and thicken.
7. Make the chocolate frosting: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar and cocoa powder, alternating with the milk, until the frosting is smooth and fluffy. Stir in the vanilla extract.
8. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread half of the pecan filling over the top. Repeat with the second layer. Place the third cake layer on top and frost the entire cake with the chocolate frosting.
9. Serve: Garnish with additional chopped pecans if desired. Chill the cake for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 40 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 10 minutes
-  Kcal: 600 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings

Message:
White Chocolate Covered Strawberry Cake 
Ingredients:
- 2  cups cake flour
- 2  tsp baking powder
-  tsp salt
- 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 4 large eggs
- 1 Tbsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup whole milk
-  cup sour cream
- 1 cup fresh strawberries, chopped
White Chocolate Buttercream:
- 1  cups unsalted butter, softened
- 4 cups powdered sugar
- 8 oz white chocolate, melted and cooled
- 2 Tbsp heavy cream
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
White Chocolate Ganache:
- 6 oz white chocolate, chopped
-  cup heavy cream
Topping:
- 1 lb fresh strawberries, whole and halved
Directions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350F and grease three 8-inch round cake pans. Line the bottoms with parchment paper and set aside.
2. In a medium bowl, sift together the cake flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
3. In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and sugar on medium-high speed until light and fluffy, about 3-4 minutes. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in the vanilla extract.
4. Alternate adding the dry ingredients with the milk and sour cream, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined. Gently fold in the chopped strawberries.
5. Divide the batter evenly among the prepared cake pans and smooth the tops. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
6. Prepare the White Chocolate Buttercream: In a large bowl, beat the butter until smooth and creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar and mix until combined. Pour in the melted white chocolate and beat until smooth. Add heavy cream and vanilla extract and beat on high until the buttercream is fluffy.
7. Once the cakes are completely cool, level the tops if necessary. Place one cake layer on a serving plate and spread a thick layer of white chocolate buttercream on top. Repeat with the second and third layers, covering the entire cake with the buttercream.
8. For the White Chocolate Ganache: Heat the heavy cream in a small saucepan until steaming. Pour over the chopped white chocolate and let it sit for 2 minutes. Stir until smooth. Let the ganache cool slightly before drizzling it over the top of the frosted cake.
9. Decorate the cake with fresh strawberries, arranging halved and whole strawberries on top. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the ganache to set.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 45 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
-  Kcal: 550 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings

Message:
樂 Peanut Butter Brownie Trifle 樂
Ingredients:
- 1 box of brownie mix plus ingredients needed for the mix
- 2 cups cold milk
- 1 package 3.9 oz instant chocolate pudding mix
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 package 8 oz cream cheese, softened
- 1 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tub 8 oz whipped topping, thawed
- 1 cup mini peanut butter cups, chopped for garnish
Directions:
1. Prepare Brownies: Follow the instructions on the brownie mix box to bake the brownies. Once done, let them cool completely, then cut into small cubes or crumble them into bite-sized pieces.
2. Make Chocolate Pudding: In a medium bowl, whisk together the cold milk and instant chocolate pudding mix. Allow the pudding to set in the refrigerator for about 5 minutes.
3. Prepare Peanut Butter Layer: In a separate bowl, beat together the softened cream cheese, peanut butter, and powdered sugar until smooth. Fold in half of the whipped topping to create a creamy peanut butter layer.
4. Assemble the Trifle: In a trifle dish or large glass bowl, layer 1/3 of the brownie cubes at the bottom. Top with half of the peanut butter mixture, followed by half of the chocolate pudding. Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining brownies on top.
5. Top with Whipped Topping: Spread the remaining whipped topping evenly over the final brownie layer. Garnish with chopped mini peanut butter cups for a delightful finish.
6. Chill and Serve: Refrigerate the trifle for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld. Serve chilled and enjoy the decadent peanut butter brownie combination!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 45 minutes plus chilling
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings

Classic Marble Cake 
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1/2 teaspoon salt 蓼
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
1/2 cup vegetable oil 
2 cups granulated sugar 
4 large eggs 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
1 cup whole milk 拏
1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder 
1/4 cup hot water 
For the Frosting Optional:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
4 cups powdered sugar 
1/4 cup whole milk 拏
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
Directions:
Preheat Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking pan or two 9-inch round cake pans.
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
Cream Butter and Sugar: In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, vegetable oil, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
Add Eggs: Beat in the eggs one at a time, making sure to mix well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Combine Ingredients: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk. Begin and end with the dry ingredients. Mix just until combined.
Make Chocolate Batter: In a small bowl, stir together the cocoa powder and hot water until smooth. Take about 1 cup of the cake batter and mix it with the cocoa mixture to create the chocolate batter.
Create Marble Effect: Spoon the vanilla and chocolate batters alternately into the prepared pans. Use a knife to gently swirl the batters together for a marbled effect.
Bake: Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Prepare Frosting Optional: In a bowl, beat the butter until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar, mixing until smooth. Add the milk and vanilla extract, then beat until light and fluffy. Spread the frosting over the cooled cake if desired.

Message:
Mocha Poke Cake 
Ingredients:
- For the Cake:
  - 1 box chocolate cake mix plus ingredients listed on the box: eggs, oil, water
  
- For the Mocha Filling:
  - 1 can 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk
  - 1/2 cup brewed coffee
  - 1/4 cup chocolate syrup
  - 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur optional, omit to remove alcohol
- For the Whipped Topping:
  - 2 cups heavy whipping cream
  - 1/4 cup powdered sugar
  - 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  - 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules optional for added coffee flavor
- For the Garnish:
  - Chocolate shavings or cocoa powder optional
  - Additional chocolate syrup optional
Directions:
1. Bake the Cake:  
   Preheat the oven to 350F 175C and grease a 9x13-inch baking pan. Prepare the chocolate cake batter according to the package instructions. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Remove from the oven and allow the cake to cool slightly.
2. Prepare the Mocha Filling:  
   In a bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk, brewed coffee, chocolate syrup, and coffee liqueur if using. Once the cake has cooled for about 10 minutes, use the handle of a wooden spoon to poke holes all over the cake.
3. Soak the Cake:  
   Slowly pour the mocha filling over the cake, making sure the mixture seeps into the holes. Spread the mixture evenly over the top. Refrigerate the cake for at least 1 hour, allowing the filling to soak in and the cake to cool completely.
4. Make the Whipped Topping:  
   In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and instant coffee granules if using until stiff peaks form. Spread the whipped topping evenly over the cooled cake.
5. Garnish and Serve:  
   Sprinkle the top with chocolate shavings, dust with cocoa powder, or drizzle additional chocolate syrup for extra indulgence. Slice the cake and enjoy the rich mocha flavor with every bite!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 45 minutes plus chilling time
-  Kcal: 400 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings

Message:
Apple Cheesecake with Caramel Sauce 
Ingredients:
- For the Crust:
  - 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
  - 2 tablespoons sugar
  - 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
- For the Cheesecake Filling
  - 2 packages 8 ounces each cream cheese, softened
  - 1/2 cup sugar
  - 2 large eggs
  - 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- For the Apple Topping:
  - 3 large apples, peeled and sliced
  - 1/4 cup sugar
  - 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  - 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- For the Caramel Sauce:
  - 1/2 cup butter
  - 1 cup packed brown sugar
  - 1/4 cup milk
  - 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  - 2 tablespoons brandy optional, omit to remove alcohol
Directions:
1. Prepare the Crust:
   Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. In a mixing bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Mix until the crumbs are well-coated. Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan, creating an even layer. Bake for 10 minutes, then set aside to cool.
2. Make the Cheesecake Filling:  
   In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and 1/2 cup of sugar until smooth and creamy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract. Pour the filling over the prepared crust and smooth the top with a spatula.
3. Bake the Cheesecake:  
   Bake the cheesecake for 35-40 minutes, or until the center is just set and slightly jiggly. Remove from the oven and allow to cool completely. Once cooled, refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to set.
4. Prepare the Apple Topping:  
   In a large skillet, melt the 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the sliced apples, sugar, and cinnamon. Cook the apples, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until tender and caramelized. Set aside to cool slightly.
5. Make the Caramel Sauce:  
   In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Stir in the brown sugar and milk, whisking until smooth. Let the mixture come to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in the vanilla extract, and the brandy if using. Let the sauce cool slightly before serving.
6. Assemble the Cheesecake:  
   Before serving, spoon the cooked apples over the chilled cheesecake. Drizzle generously with the caramel sauce.
7. Serve:  
   Slice and enjoy the rich, creamy apple cheesecake with warm caramel sauce on top.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 30 minutes  Cooking Time: 40 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 10 minutes plus chilling time
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 8 servings

Message:
Chicken Pot Pie Pasta 
Ingredients:
- 12 ounces pasta penne, rotini, or your choice
- 2 cups cooked chicken, shredded or cubed
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1/2 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 cup frozen peas and carrots
- 1/2 cup frozen corn
- 1 can 10.5 ounces cream of chicken soup
- 1 1/2 cups chicken broth
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese optional, for topping
- Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Directions:
1. Cook the Pasta: In a large pot, bring salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
2. Sauté Vegetables: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the frozen peas, carrots, and corn, cooking for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
3. Make the Sauce: Add the cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, milk, and dried thyme to the skillet. Stir until everything is well combined. Let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
4. Combine the Chicken and Pasta: Stir in the cooked chicken and drained pasta, tossing everything together until evenly coated in the creamy sauce.
5. Optional Cheese Topping: If desired, sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the pasta mixture and let it melt for a minute or two.
6. Serve: Garnish the chicken pot pie pasta with fresh parsley and serve immediately. Enjoy this comforting, hearty dish!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
-  Kcal: 400 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings

Ingredients:

- 2 cups fresh or frozen broccoli florets, steamed
- 1 can 10.5 ounces cream of mushroom soup

- 1/4 cup milk

Message:
數 Crock Pot Pepper Steak 數
Ingredients:
- 2 pounds beef sirloin, thinly sliced into strips
- 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
- 1 onion, thinly sliced
- 2 bell peppers green, red, or yellow, thinly sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 can 14.5 ounces diced tomatoes with liquid
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch
- 1/2 cup beef broth
- 1 teaspoon ground ginger
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- Cooked rice, for serving
Directions:
1. Sear the Beef: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef strips and sear them until browned on all sides. Transfer the beef to your crock pot.
2. Prepare the Vegetables: In the same skillet, add the sliced onions and bell peppers. Sauté for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften. Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute. Transfer the vegetables to the crock pot with the beef.
3. Make the Sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together the diced tomatoes with their liquid, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, beef broth, ground ginger, and black pepper. Pour this mixture over the beef and vegetables in the crock pot.
4. Cook in the Crock Pot: Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or on high for 3-4 hours, until the beef is tender.
5. Thicken the Sauce: About 30 minutes before serving, whisk the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of water to create a slurry. Stir the cornstarch slurry into the crock pot to thicken the sauce. Let it cook for the remaining time.
6. Serve: Serve the pepper steak over cooked rice, and enjoy this hearty and flavorful meal!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 6-7 hours low or 3-4 hours high  Total Time: 6-7 hours
-  Kcal: 350 kcal per serving   Servings: 6 servings
#CrockPotPepperSteak #SlowCookerMeals #BeefRecipes #ComfortFood #EasyDinners

Message:
No-Bake Lemon Éclair Cake 
Ingredients:
- 2 3.4 oz boxes instant lemon pudding mix
- 3 cups cold milk
- 1 8 oz container whipped topping, thawed
- 1 box graham crackers
- 1/4 cup lemon juice optional, for extra lemon flavor
For the Lemon Glaze:
- 1 cup powdered sugar
- 2 tablespoons lemon juice
- 1 tablespoon milk
Directions:
1. Make the Lemon Pudding: In a large bowl, whisk together the instant lemon pudding mix and cold milk until smooth and thickened, about 2-3 minutes. Gently fold in the whipped topping until fully combined. If you want an extra lemony flavor, stir in the optional lemon juice.
2. Assemble the Cake: In a 9x13-inch dish, place a single layer of graham crackers at the bottom, breaking them to fit if necessary. Spread half of the lemon pudding mixture evenly over the graham crackers. Add another layer of graham crackers on top of the pudding, then spread the remaining pudding mixture over the crackers. Finish with one last layer of graham crackers on top.
3. Make the Lemon Glaze: In a small bowl, whisk together the powdered sugar, lemon juice, and milk until smooth. Pour the glaze over the top layer of graham crackers, spreading it out evenly.
4. Chill: Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. This allows the graham crackers to soften and the flavors to meld together.
5. Serve: Slice and enjoy this refreshing and creamy lemon éclair cake. Its a perfect no-bake dessert for any occasion!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Chilling Time: 4 hours  Total Time: 4 hours 15 minutes
-  Kcal: 300 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings
#NoBakeLemonCake #LemonEclairCake #EasyDesserts #SummerTreats #NoBakeRecipes

Message:
Apple Fries 
Ingredients:
- 4 large green apples Granny Smith or similar, peeled and sliced into fry-like sticks
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
- 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup milk
- Vegetable oil, for frying
For the Cinnamon Sugar Coating:
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
For Dipping Sauce Optional:
- 1/2 cup caramel sauce or vanilla ice cream for dipping
Directions:
1. Prepare the Apple Fries: Peel and slice the apples into thick sticks, similar to fries. Set them aside.
2. Make the Batter: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, granulated sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the milk and stir until you have a smooth batter.
3. Heat the Oil: In a large frying pan, heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil over medium-high heat until it reaches 350F 175C.
4. Coat and Fry the Apples: Dip each apple stick into the batter, shaking off the excess. Carefully place the coated apple slices into the hot oil in batches. Fry for 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy. Remove from the oil and drain on paper towels.

Message:
30-Minute Chocolate Fudge Cake 
Ingredients:
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup boiling water
For the Fudge Frosting:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter
- 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/4 cup milk
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour an 8x8-inch baking dish or line it with parchment paper.
2. Make the Cake Batter: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the melted butter, milk, egg, and vanilla extract. Mix until the batter is smooth and well combined. Stir in the boiling water until fully incorporated the batter will be thin.
3. Bake the Cake: Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cake to cool slightly while you prepare the fudge frosting.
4. Make the Fudge Frosting: In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Stir in the cocoa powder and cook for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and whisk in the milk, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth.
5. Frost the Cake: While the cake is still warm, pour the fudge frosting over the top, spreading it evenly with a spatula. Let the frosting set for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
6. Serve: Slice and enjoy this rich, fudgy chocolate cake with a glass of milk or a scoop of ice cream!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
-  Kcal: 350 kcal per serving   Servings: 9 servings

Message:
凜龍 Creamy Garlic Sauce Baby Potatoes 龍凜
Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 pounds baby potatoes
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Directions:
1. Boil the Potatoes: In a large pot, bring salted water to a boil. Add the baby potatoes and cook for about 15-20 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork. Drain the potatoes and set them aside.
2. Prepare the Creamy Garlic Sauce: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant but not browned. Stir in the butter and let it melt.
3. Make it Creamy: Pour in the heavy cream and add the dried thyme. Simmer the mixture for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce begins to thicken. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
4. Coat the Potatoes: Add the cooked baby potatoes to the skillet with the creamy garlic sauce. Gently toss the potatoes in the sauce until they are fully coated and warmed through.
5. Serve: Transfer the creamy garlic potatoes to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley. Serve immediately and enjoy the rich, flavorful sauce with tender baby potatoes.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
-  Kcal: 280 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings

Message:
Snickerdoodle Cobbler 
Ingredients:
- 1 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 teaspoons baking powder
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1 1/2 cups whole milk
- 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
- 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
- 1 1/2 cups boiling water
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Pour the melted butter into a 9x13-inch baking dish, spreading it evenly.
2. Prepare the Batter: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together 1 cup of the granulated sugar, flour, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the milk and vanilla extract until the batter is smooth. Pour the batter evenly over the melted butter in the baking dishdo not stir.
3. Make the Cinnamon Sugar Topping: In a small bowl, mix together the remaining 1/2 cup granulated sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar mixture evenly over the batter.
4. Add Boiling Water: Slowly and carefully pour the boiling water over the top of the cobbler. Again, do not stir. The water will help form a gooey, cinnamon-sugar layer as it bakes.
5. Bake the Cobbler: Place the cobbler in the preheated oven and bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the top is golden and set, and the edges are bubbling.
6. Serve: Let the cobbler cool for about 10 minutes before serving. This snickerdoodle cobbler is perfect on its own or with a scoop of vanilla ice cream!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 45 minutes  Total Time: 55 minutes
-  Kcal: 380 kcal per serving   Servings: 8 servings

Message:
Chicken Spaghetti Casserole 
Ingredients:
- 12 ounces spaghetti
- 2 cups cooked chicken, shredded
- 1 can 10.5 ounces cream of chicken soup
- 1 can 10.5 ounces cream of mushroom soup
- 1 can 10 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained
- 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 1/2 cup chopped onion
- 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1/2 teaspoon paprika
- Salt and pepper to taste
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
2. Cook the Spaghetti: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the spaghetti and cook according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
3. Make the Sauce: In a large mixing bowl, combine the cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, diced tomatoes with green chilies, chicken broth, chopped onion, chopped bell pepper, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir until well combined.
4. Assemble the Casserole: Add the cooked spaghetti and shredded chicken to the bowl with the sauce. Stir until the spaghetti and chicken are well coated with the sauce. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish.
5. Add Cheese: Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the casserole.
6. Bake the Casserole: Place the casserole in the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the casserole is bubbling. 
7. Garnish and Serve: Remove from the oven and top with the remaining 1/2 cup of cheddar cheese. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 45 minutes
-  Kcal: 400 kcal per serving   Servings: 6 servings

不 Pecan Pie Cookies 不
Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
For the Pecan Filling:
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter
- 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
- 1 tablespoon heavy cream
- 3/4 cup chopped pecans
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Prepare the Cookie Dough: In a large mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add the egg and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a soft dough forms.
3. Shape the Cookies: Roll the dough into 1-inch balls and place them on the prepared baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Use your thumb or the back of a spoon to make an indentation in the center of each dough ball.
4. Make the Pecan Filling: In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter and stir in the brown sugar and heavy cream. Bring the mixture to a simmer, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in the chopped pecans.
5. Fill the Cookies: Spoon a small amount of the pecan filling into each indentation in the cookies.
6. Bake the Cookies: Bake the cookies in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden. Remove from the oven and allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
7. Serve: These pecan pie cookies are best enjoyed once fully cooled. Store them in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 12 minutes  Total Time: 27 minutes
-  Kcal: 140 kcal per cookie   Servings: 24 cookies

Message:
療 Cinnamon Sugar French Toast Muffins 療
Ingredients:
- 10 slices of bread day-old or slightly stale, cubed
- 4 large eggs
- 1 cup whole milk
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- Pinch of salt
- 2 tablespoons melted butter
For the Cinnamon Sugar Coating:
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 2 tablespoons melted butter
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease a muffin tin with non-stick spray or butter.
2. Prepare the Bread Cubes: Cut the bread slices into cubes and set them aside in a large mixing bowl.
3. Make the Egg Mixture: In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt until well combined.
4. Combine Bread and Egg Mixture: Pour the egg mixture over the bread cubes. Gently toss the bread to ensure each piece is soaked in the mixture. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes so the bread absorbs the liquid.
5. Fill the Muffin Tin: Evenly divide the soaked bread mixture into the prepared muffin tin, pressing down lightly to compact the bread. Drizzle the tops with melted butter.
6. Bake the Muffins: Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the tops are golden and the muffins are set. Remove the muffins from the oven and allow them to cool slightly in the tin.
7. Cinnamon Sugar Coating: In a small bowl, mix together the sugar and cinnamon. Brush the tops of the warm muffins with melted butter and then dip them into the cinnamon sugar mixture to coat.
8. Serve: Enjoy these warm, fluffy French toast muffins with a drizzle of maple syrup or as-is for a perfect breakfast treat!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
-  Kcal: 160 kcal per muffin   Servings: 12 muffins

Message:
樂 Pecan Pie Balls 樂
Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 cups finely chopped pecans
- 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
- 1 cup brown sugar, packed
- 1/2 cup maple syrup
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup chocolate chips for coating
- 1 tablespoon coconut oil optional, for smoother coating
Directions:
1. Prepare the Mixture: In a large bowl, combine the finely chopped pecans, graham cracker crumbs, and brown sugar. Stir in the maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt until the mixture comes together and is well combined.
2. Form the Balls: Scoop out tablespoon-sized portions of the pecan mixture and roll them into balls. Place the formed balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Freeze for about 20-30 minutes, or until firm.
3. Melt the Chocolate: In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the chocolate chips in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until fully melted and smooth. If desired, stir in the coconut oil for a shinier and smoother coating.
4. Coat the Pecan Balls: Using a fork or toothpick, dip each pecan ball into the melted chocolate, ensuring it is evenly coated. Place the chocolate-covered balls back onto the parchment-lined baking sheet.
5. Chill and Set: Once all the balls are coated, refrigerate them for at least 1 hour, or until the chocolate is fully set.
6. Serve: These pecan pie balls are ready to enjoy once the chocolate has hardened. Store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 20 minutes  Chilling Time: 1 hour  Total Time: 1 hour 20 minutes
-  Kcal: 180 kcal per ball   Servings: 24 pecan pie balls

1. Prepare the Mixture: In a large bowl, combine the finely chopped pecans, graham cracker crumbs, and brown sugar. Stir in the maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt until the mixture comes together and is well combined.
2. Form the Balls: Scoop out tablespoon-sized portions of the pecan mixture and roll them into balls. Place the formed balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Freeze for about 20-30 minutes, or until firm.
3. Melt the Chocolate: In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the chocolate chips in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until fully melted and smooth. If desired, stir in the coconut oil for a shinier and smoother coating.
4. Coat the Pecan Balls: Using a fork or toothpick, dip each pecan ball into the melted chocolate, ensuring it is evenly coated. Place the chocolate-covered balls back onto the parchment-lined baking sheet.

Soft Batch Pumpkin Sugar Cookies 
Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup light brown sugar, packed
- 1/4 cup pumpkin puree
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
For the Sugar Coating:
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.
2. Mix the Dry Ingredients: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger. Set aside.
3. Cream the Butter and Sugars: In a large mixing bowl, beat the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2-3 minutes. Add the pumpkin puree, egg, and vanilla extract, mixing until smooth and fully combined.
4. Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients: Gradually add the dry ingredients into the wet mixture, stirring until just combined. Be careful not to overmix the dough.
5. Prepare the Sugar Coating: In a small bowl, mix the granulated sugar and ground cinnamon for the sugar coating.
6. Shape the Cookies: Scoop out tablespoon-sized portions of the dough and roll them into balls. Roll each ball in the cinnamon-sugar mixture until coated. Place the cookie dough balls onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
7. Bake the Cookies: Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden but the centers remain soft. Remove from the oven and let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
8. Serve: Enjoy these soft and chewy pumpkin sugar cookies with a hot cup of coffee or tea!

Message:
不 Grandmas Chocolate Pie 不
Ingredients:
- 1 pre-made or homemade pie crust, baked
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 2 cups whole milk
- 3 large egg yolks, lightly beaten
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
For the Meringue:
- 3 large egg whites
- 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
Directions:
1. Pre-bake the Crust: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Prepare your pie crust by either making it from scratch or using a store-bought one. Bake the crust according to the package or recipe instructions, and allow it to cool completely.
2. Make the Chocolate Filling: In a medium saucepan, whisk together the sugar, flour, cocoa powder, and salt. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil. This should take about 5-7 minutes.
3. Temper the Eggs: In a small bowl, whisk the beaten egg yolks. Slowly add a small amount about 1/4 cup of the hot chocolate mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly to temper the eggs and prevent curdling. Then, pour the tempered egg mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining chocolate filling. Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until thickened.
4. Add Butter and Vanilla: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the butter and vanilla extract until the butter melts and the filling is smooth. Pour the chocolate filling into the pre-baked pie crust.
5. Prepare the Meringue: In a large mixing bowl, beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Gradually add the sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, and continue to beat until stiff peaks form.
6. Add the Meringue to the Pie: Spread the meringue over the warm chocolate filling, making sure to seal the edges of the pie crust to prevent shrinking. Use the back of a spoon to create peaks on the meringue.
7. Bake the Pie: Place the pie in the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the meringue is golden brown. Remove from the oven and allow the pie to cool to room temperature before slicing.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 12 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour including cooling
-  Kcal: 340 kcal per serving   Servings: 8 servings

Message:
樂 Butter Pecan Praline Poke Cake 樂
Ingredients:
- 1 box butter pecan cake mix
- 3 large eggs
- 1 cup water
- 1/3 cup vegetable oil
- 1/2 cup chopped pecans
- 1 can 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk
- 1 jar 11.75 ounces caramel sauce
- 1/4 cup bourbon optional
- 1 container 8 ounces whipped topping, thawed
- 1/2 cup toffee bits
- 1/2 cup chopped pecans for topping
Directions:
1. Prepare the Cake: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking pan. In a large bowl, mix the butter pecan cake mix, eggs, water, and vegetable oil until well combined. Fold in the chopped pecans. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
2. Poke Holes in Cake: Once the cake is out of the oven, let it cool for about 10 minutes. Using the handle of a wooden spoon, poke holes evenly across the entire surface of the cake.
3. Add the Filling: In a medium bowl, combine the sweetened condensed milk, caramel sauce, and bourbon if using. Pour this mixture over the cake, ensuring it seeps into the holes. Let the cake cool completely.
4. Top with Whipped Topping: Spread the thawed whipped topping evenly over the cooled cake. 
5. Garnish: Sprinkle the top of the cake with toffee bits and the remaining chopped pecans.
6. Serve: Chill the cake in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving. This will allow the flavors to meld together. Slice and enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 2 hours 40 minutes including chilling time
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 servings
#ButterPecanCake #PralinePokeCake #DessertLovers #SouthernDesserts #CakeRecipes

Message:
Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup 
Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- 1 teaspoon chili powder
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1 teaspoon onion powder
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 1 can 10 ounces diced tomatoes with green chiles
- 1 can 15 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed
- 1 can 15 ounces corn, drained
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 4 cups chicken broth
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro optional
- Juice of 1 lime
- Tortilla strips, for serving
- Shredded cheese, avocado slices, and sour cream optional, for serving
Directions:
1. Season the Chicken: In a small bowl, mix the cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Rub the seasoning mix evenly over the chicken breasts.
2. Prepare the Slow Cooker: In a slow cooker, combine the seasoned chicken breasts, diced tomatoes with green chiles, black beans, corn, and chopped onion. Pour the chicken broth over the top.
3. Cook: Cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours, until the chicken is tender and fully cooked.
4. Shred the Chicken: Once cooked, remove the chicken breasts from the slow cooker and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the slow cooker and stir to combine.
5. Finish with Lime and Cilantro: Stir in the lime juice and fresh cilantro, if using. Let the soup heat through for an additional 10 minutes.
6. Serve: Ladle the soup into bowls and top with tortilla strips. Garnish with shredded cheese, avocado slices, and sour cream if desired. Enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 6 hours low or 3 hours high  Total Time: 6-8 hours
-  Kcal: 350 kcal per serving   Servings: 6 servings
#ChickenTortillaSoup #SlowCookerMeals #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #HealthyRecipes

Message:
凜燎 Crispy Potato Balls 燎凜
Ingredients:
- 4 large potatoes, peeled and chopped
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
- 2 eggs, beaten
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1 teaspoon onion powder
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1 cup breadcrumbs
- Vegetable oil for frying
Directions:
1. Boil the Potatoes: Place the chopped potatoes in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork-tender. Drain and transfer the potatoes to a large bowl.
2. Mash the Potatoes: Add the butter, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper to the potatoes. Mash everything together until smooth and well combined.
3. Form the Potato Balls: Once the mashed potatoes are cool enough to handle, take about 1-2 tablespoons of the mixture and form it into a small ball. Make an indentation in the center of each ball and add a little mozzarella cheese. Roll the ball to seal the cheese inside. Repeat until all the potato mixture is used.
4. Coat the Balls: Set up a breading station with three bowls: one with flour, one with beaten eggs, and one with breadcrumbs. Roll each potato ball in the flour, then dip it into the egg mixture, and finally coat it in breadcrumbs. Ensure each ball is fully coated.
5. Fry the Potato Balls: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat about 350F/175C. Fry the potato balls in batches, turning them occasionally, until golden brown and crispy on all sides, about 3-4 minutes. Remove and drain on a paper towel-lined plate.
6. Serve: Serve the crispy potato balls hot as a delicious snack or appetizer. They pair perfectly with your favorite dipping sauce!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cook Time: 15 minutes  Total Time: 35 minutes
-  Kcal: 250 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 potato balls

Message:
Chicken and Rice One-Pot Dinner 
Ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 small onion, diced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1  cups long-grain rice, rinsed
- 3 cups chicken broth
- 1 teaspoon soy sauce
- 1 teaspoon sesame oil
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric optional, for color
- 1 cup frozen peas and carrots
- 2 green onions, chopped for garnish
Directions:
1. Sear the Chicken: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then add them to the pot. Sear the chicken for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown but not fully cooked. Remove from the pot and set aside.
2. Sauté Aromatics: In the same pot, add the diced onion and garlic. Cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant and the onions are softened.
3. Add Rice and Broth: Stir in the rinsed rice, making sure it gets coated with the onion and garlic mixture. Add the chicken broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, black pepper, and ground turmeric if using. Stir to combine.
4. Return the Chicken and Simmer: Place the seared chicken breasts back into the pot on top of the rice. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165F 74C.
5. Add Vegetables: When the rice is almost done, stir in the frozen peas and carrots. Cover and cook for an additional 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender and everything is heated through.
6. Serve: Remove the chicken, slice or shred it, and serve it over the rice. Garnish with chopped green onions and enjoy this delicious one-pot meal!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cook Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
-  Kcal: 400 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings

Message:
Grilled Chicken Spaghetti 
Ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1 teaspoon onion powder
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 12 ounces spaghetti
- 1 can 14.5 ounces diced tomatoes
- 1 can 15 ounces tomato sauce
- 1 small onion, diced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning
- 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes optional
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- Fresh basil or parsley for garnish
Directions:
1. Season and Grill the Chicken: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat. Rub the chicken breasts with olive oil and season with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Grill the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 165F 74C. Once cooked, remove from the grill and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
2. Cook the Spaghetti: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
3. Prepare the Sauce: In a large skillet over medium heat, add a drizzle of olive oil and sauté the diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 3 minutes. Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes if using. Stir to combine and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes to allow the flavors to develop.
4. Combine the Pasta and Chicken: Add the cooked spaghetti to the sauce and toss to coat the pasta evenly. Stir in the sliced grilled chicken, ensuring everything is well mixed and heated through.
5. Serve and Garnish: Serve the grilled chicken spaghetti topped with grated Parmesan cheese and fresh basil or parsley. Enjoy this smoky, hearty pasta dish!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cook Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings

讀 Deviled Egg Pasta Salad 讀
Ingredients:
8 ounces elbow macaroni or pasta of your choice
6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped
1/2 cup mayonnaise
2 tablespoons yellow mustard
2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
1 tablespoon sweet pickle relish
1 teaspoon paprika
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon black pepper

Paprika for garnish

Mix in the Ingredients: Add the cooked pasta, chopped hard-boiled eggs, and diced red onion to the dressing. Gently toss everything together until the pasta and eggs are evenly coated with the dressing.
Chill the Salad: Cover the pasta salad and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld.

Message:
Pumpkin Pie Crisp with Streusel Topping 不
Ingredients:
For the Pumpkin Filling:
- 1 can 15 ounces pumpkin puree
- 1 can 12 ounces evaporated milk
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
- 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
For the Streusel Topping:
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup old-fashioned oats
- 1/2 cup packed brown sugar
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1/2 cup chopped pecans optional
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Set your oven to 375F 190C and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
2. Prepare the Pumpkin Filling: In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, evaporated milk, granulated sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, nutmeg, and salt until smooth and fully combined. Pour the pumpkin mixture into the prepared baking dish and spread it evenly.
3. Make the Streusel Topping: In a separate bowl, combine the flour, oats, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Pour in the melted butter and mix until the dry ingredients are moistened and crumbly. If using, stir in the chopped pecans.
4. Add the Topping: Evenly sprinkle the streusel topping over the pumpkin filling, covering it entirely.
5. Bake: Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the pumpkin filling is set. You can test the doneness by inserting a toothpick into the center; it should come out clean or with a few moist crumbs.
6. Cool and Serve: Allow the pumpkin pie crisp to cool slightly before serving. Enjoy it warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or whipped cream for an extra treat!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cook Time: 45 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour
-  Kcal: 350 kcal per serving   Servings: 10 servings
#PumpkinCrisp #StreuselTopping #FallDesserts #PumpkinRecipes #EasyDessert

Message:
Sweetened Condensed Milk Snowballs 便
Ingredients:
- 1 can 300 mL sweetened condensed milk
- 4 cups sweetened shredded coconut
- 1  cups graham cracker crumbs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 pinch of salt
- Extra shredded coconut for rolling
Directions:
1. Mix the Ingredients: In a large mixing bowl, combine the sweetened condensed milk, shredded coconut, graham cracker crumbs, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt. Stir until all the ingredients are well combined and a sticky dough forms.
2. Chill the Dough: Place the bowl in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to allow the mixture to firm up. This makes it easier to shape into balls.
3. Shape the Snowballs: After chilling, take small portions of the dough about 1 tablespoon each and roll them between your palms to form bite-sized balls.
4. Roll in Coconut: Roll each ball in extra shredded coconut, ensuring theyre fully coated for a snowy appearance.
5. Refrigerate: Place the coated snowballs onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Chill them in the refrigerator for another 30 minutes to set.
6. Serve and Enjoy: Once firm, serve these delicious sweetened condensed milk snowballs as a sweet treat! Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Chill Time: 1 hour  Total Time: 1 hour 10 minutes
-  Kcal: 150 kcal per serving   Servings: 24 snowballs

Message:
Easy Chocolate Fudge Cake 
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup cocoa powder unsweetened
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 2 large eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 1/2 cup boiling water
- 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips optional
For the Chocolate Frosting:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup cocoa powder unsweetened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and line two 8-inch round cake pans with parchment paper.
2. Make the Cake Batter: In a large bowl, sift together the flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the granulated sugar and brown sugar, and mix well.
3. Combine Wet Ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, and buttermilk. Gradually pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, mixing until combined.
4. Add the Boiling Water: Slowly add the boiling water to the batter and stir until smooth. The batter will be thin. If desired, fold in the semi-sweet chocolate chips for extra richness.
5. Bake the Cakes: Divide the batter evenly between the prepared cake pans. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
6. Make the Chocolate Frosting: In a medium bowl, beat the softened butter until smooth. Add the cocoa powder and powdered sugar, alternating with the milk, and mix until light and fluffy. Stir in the vanilla extract.
7. Assemble the Cake: Once the cakes are completely cool, frost the top of one cake layer. Place the second layer on top and frost the entire cake, covering the sides evenly.
8. Serve: Slice and enjoy this rich, fudgy chocolate cake with a decadent frosting!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 35 minutes  Total Time: 55 minutes
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 10-12 slices

Message:
Chocolate Caramel Oat Bars Carmelitas 
Ingredients:
- 3/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 3/4 cup brown sugar, packed
- 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup old-fashioned rolled oats
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
- 1 cup caramel sauce store-bought or homemade
- 1/4 teaspoon sea salt optional, for sprinkling
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease an 8x8-inch baking dish and line it with parchment paper, leaving an overhang for easy removal.
2. Make the Oat Mixture: In a large bowl, mix together the melted butter, brown sugar, and vanilla extract until combined. Add the flour, oats, baking soda, and salt, stirring until a thick dough forms.
3. Layer the Base: Press half of the oat mixture evenly into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Bake for 10 minutes, or until the crust starts to set and turn lightly golden.
4. Add the Chocolate and Caramel: Remove the crust from the oven and sprinkle the chocolate chips evenly over the top. Drizzle the caramel sauce over the chocolate chips, spreading it evenly to cover.
5. Top and Bake Again: Crumble the remaining oat mixture over the caramel and chocolate layer. Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden and the caramel is bubbling.
6. Cool and Set: Remove from the oven and let the bars cool completely in the pan. If desired, sprinkle with a little sea salt for extra flavor. For clean slices, you can refrigerate the bars for 30 minutes to firm up.
7. Serve: Once cooled and set, slice into squares and enjoy these gooey, indulgent caramel oat bars!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 25 minutes  Total Time: 35 minutes
-  Kcal: 320 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 bars
#Carmelitas #ChocolateCaramelBars #OatBars #GooeyDesserts #EasyBaking

Message:
療 Raspberry Lemon Heaven Cupcakes 療
Ingredients:
For the Cupcakes:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 2 tablespoons lemon zest
- 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 cup fresh raspberries or frozen, thawed
For the Lemon Buttercream Frosting:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
- 1 tablespoon lemon zest
- 1-2 tablespoons milk as needed for consistency
For Garnish:
- Fresh raspberries
- Lemon slices optional
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with cupcake liners.
2. Make the Cupcake Batter: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. In a large bowl, cream the softened butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
3. Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients: Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter mixture, alternating with the milk. Mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the raspberries.
4. Bake the Cupcakes: Divide the batter evenly among the cupcake liners, filling each about 2/3 full. Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cupcakes cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
5. Prepare the Lemon Buttercream Frosting: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Mix in the lemon juice and zest. Add milk, one tablespoon at a time, until you achieve your desired frosting consistency.
6. Frost the Cupcakes: Once the cupcakes are completely cool, generously frost them with the lemon buttercream.
7. Garnish and Serve: Top each cupcake with a fresh raspberry and a small lemon slice if desired. Serve and enjoy the bright, refreshing flavors of these lemon and raspberry treats!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 35 minutes
-  Kcal: 320 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 cupcakes
#RaspberryLemonCupcakes #LemonButtercream #CupcakeHeaven #SummerFlavors #BakingJoy

Message:
療 Salted Caramel Cupcakes 療
Ingredients:
For the Cupcakes:
1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 cup milk
For the Salted Caramel Sauce:
1 cup granulated sugar
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cubed
1/2 cup heavy cream
1 teaspoon sea salt or to taste
For the Salted Caramel Frosting:
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
2 1/2 cups powdered sugar
1/4 cup salted caramel sauce from above
Directions:
Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with cupcake liners.
Make the Cupcake Batter: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in the vanilla extract.
Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients: Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter mixture, alternating with the milk. Start and end with the flour mixture, mixing just until combined.
Bake the Cupcakes: Divide the batter evenly among the cupcake liners, filling each about 2/3 full. Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cupcakes to cool completely on a wire rack before frosting.
Make the Salted Caramel Sauce: In a medium saucepan, heat the granulated sugar over medium heat, stirring constantly until it melts and turns a deep amber color. Carefully add the butter and stir until melted. Slowly whisk in the heavy cream the mixture will bubble vigorously. Remove from heat and stir in the sea salt. Let the caramel cool to room temperature before using.
Prepare the Salted Caramel Frosting: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar, mixing until light and fluffy. Add 1/4 cup of the cooled salted caramel sauce and beat until smooth.
Frost the Cupcakes: Frost each cooled cupcake generously with the salted caramel frosting. Drizzle with additional salted caramel sauce and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt for garnish.
Serve: Enjoy these decadent salted caramel cupcakes with a luscious caramel finish!
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
 Kcal: 350 kcal per serving   Servings: 12 cupcakes

Message:
Pumpkin Coffee Cake Cookies 
Ingredients:
For the Cookies:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed
- 1/2 cup pumpkin puree
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
For the Crumb Topping:
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
- 3/4 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
For the Glaze:
- 1 cup powdered sugar
- 1-2 tablespoons milk
- 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.
2. Make the Cookie Dough: In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Mix in the pumpkin puree, egg, and vanilla extract until fully combined.
3. Add Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a soft dough forms.
4. Prepare the Crumb Topping: In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon. Mix with a fork until crumbly.
5. Shape the Cookies: Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of cookie dough and place them on the prepared baking sheet. Flatten each ball slightly with the back of a spoon.
6. Add the Crumb Topping: Generously sprinkle the crumb topping over each cookie, gently pressing it into the dough.
7. Bake: Bake the cookies for 12-14 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden and the cookies are set. Remove from the oven and let them cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
8. Make the Glaze: In a small bowl, whisk together the powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Drizzle the glaze over the cooled cookies.
9. Serve: Once the glaze has set, enjoy these delicious pumpkin coffee cake cookies with a cup of coffee or tea!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 14 minutes  Total Time: 29 minutes
-  Kcal: 200 kcal per serving   Servings: 20 cookies

Message:
異 Mongolian Beef Ramen Noodles 異
Ingredients:
- 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
- 2 tablespoons cornstarch
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1/4 cup soy sauce low sodium
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced
- 1/2 cup water
- 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes optional
- 3 packages 3 oz each instant ramen noodles seasoning packets discarded
- 1/4 cup green onions, sliced
- 1 tablespoon sesame seeds optional, for garnish
Directions:
1. Prepare the Beef: In a bowl, toss the thinly sliced flank steak with cornstarch until fully coated. Let it sit for 10 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients.
2. Cook the Beef: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the beef in a single layer, and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until browned. Work in batches if needed to avoid overcrowding. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
3. Make the Sauce: In the same skillet, add the remaining tablespoon of vegetable oil. Sauté the minced garlic and ginger for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the soy sauce, brown sugar, water, and red pepper flakes. Let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes until it thickens slightly.
4. Cook the Noodles: While the sauce simmers, bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
5. Combine Everything: Add the cooked beef back into the skillet with the sauce and toss to coat. Add the cooked ramen noodles to the skillet, stirring to combine everything evenly.
6. Serve: Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds if desired. Serve the Mongolian beef ramen noodles hot and enjoy!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 15 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings
#MongolianBeef #RamenNoodles #QuickDinner #AsianInspired #EasyMeals

Message:
Creamy Italian Chicken Pasta 
Ingredients:
- 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 1 envelope Italian salad dressing mix about 0.7 ounces
- 1/4 cup water
- 8 ounces cream cheese, softened
- 1 can 10.5 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
- 2 cups cooked white rice or pasta for serving
- Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Directions:
1. Prep the Chicken: Place the chicken breasts in a slow cooker. Sprinkle the Italian salad dressing mix evenly over the chicken. Pour the water into the slow cooker.
2. Make the Cream Sauce: In a medium bowl, mix together the softened cream cheese, condensed cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, garlic powder, onion powder, and black pepper until smooth.
3. Cook in Slow Cooker: Pour the cream sauce mixture over the chicken breasts in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours or on high for 2-3 hours, until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.

Message:
White Chocolate Raspberry Cake 
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
- 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 4 ounces white chocolate, melted
- 1 cup fresh raspberries
For the White Chocolate Frosting:
- 6 ounces white chocolate, melted and slightly cooled
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2-3 tablespoons heavy cream
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
For Garnish:
- Fresh raspberries
- White chocolate shavings optional
Directions:
1. Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and line two 8-inch round cake pans with parchment paper.
2. Mix Dry Ingredients: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
3. Cream Butter and Sugar: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2-3 minutes. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in the vanilla extract.
4. Add Dry Ingredients and Buttermilk: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture in three parts, alternating with the buttermilk. Start and end with the dry ingredients, mixing just until combined.
5. Incorporate White Chocolate and Raspberries: Fold in the melted white chocolate until evenly distributed. Gently fold in the fresh raspberries.
6. Bake: Divide the batter evenly between the prepared cake pans. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
7. Make the White Chocolate Frosting: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter until smooth. Gradually add the powdered sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Slowly mix in the melted white chocolate, vanilla extract, and enough heavy cream to achieve a smooth, spreadable consistency.
8. Assemble the Cake: Once the cakes are completely cool, spread a layer of frosting on top of one cake layer. Place the second layer on top and frost the entire cake with the remaining white chocolate frosting.
9. Garnish and Serve: Decorate with fresh raspberries and white chocolate shavings if desired. Slice and enjoy this decadent, fruity dessert!
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 50 minutes
-  Kcal: 450 kcal per serving   Servings: 10 slices

Message:
數 Garlic Butter Steak Bites 數
Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 pounds sirloin steak, cut into bite-sized cubes
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 4 tablespoons unsalted butter
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1 teaspoon paprika
- 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
- Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Directions:
1. Season the Steak: In a large bowl, season the cubed steak with salt, pepper, paprika, and onion powder. Toss to coat the steak evenly.
2. Sear the Steak Bites: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add half of the steak bites in a single layer, making sure not to overcrowd the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until a nice brown crust forms. Remove from the skillet and repeat with the remaining steak, adding more olive oil if necessary.
3. Make the Garlic Butter: Once all the steak bites are cooked, lower the heat to medium and add the butter to the skillet. When the butter melts, stir in the minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute, until fragrant.
4. Coat the Steak Bites: Return the cooked steak bites to the skillet and toss them in the garlic butter sauce until well coated.
5. Serve: Transfer the steak bites to a serving dish and garnish with freshly chopped parsley. Serve immediately with your favorite sides or as an appetizer.
Nutritional Information:
-  Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 20 minutes
-  Kcal: 400 kcal per serving   Servings: 4 servings
